achilles-affections-of-the-goddess.line: A goddess's favour: tougher, harder-hitting and curse-proof for a turn.
achilles-affections-of-the-goddess.icon: A sea-mother's hand of water cupping a small bronze helm, droplets rising like pearls. A cupped curve around a dome. Guard blue water, bronze helm, gold pearls. Reads at 24px as: a blue cupped hand holding a dome.
achilles-affections-of-the-goddess.lore: A blessing from his mother, the sea goddess Thetis, that raises all of Achilles' parameters by a rank except Mana and Luck.

achilles-akhilleus-kosmos.line: Achilles' shield: shoves aside anyone in his path as he moves.
achilles-akhilleus-kosmos.icon: A round bronze shield seen face-on, its face a tiny world of concentric rings, ocean currents swirling at the rim. A perfect disc with rings. Bronze and white-gold, guard-blue sea at the rim. Reads at 24px as: a ringed gold disc.
achilles-akhilleus-kosmos.lore: A defensive Bounded Field Noble Phantasm in the form of a shield said to be forged by Hephaestus, comparable to Rho Aias. It shows the world Achilles saw and can stop Anti-Fortress, Anti-Country and Anti-God attacks.
achilles-akhilleus-kosmos.look: A shield bearing the world he saw, with swirling ocean currents around its rim from the sea god.

achilles-andreias-amarantos.line: Nearly invulnerable: only the divine can hurt him, and barely.
achilles-andreias-amarantos.icon: An amaranth flower that never wilts, blooming from a bronze greave, its petals glowing. A flower atop a leg-shape. Crimson-violet amaranth, bronze greave, gold light. Reads at 24px as: a bloom on a stem.
achilles-andreias-amarantos.lore: The immortality given by Thetis, which nullifies attacks, except those from enemies with Divinity at or above a certain rank. It vanishes if his heel is pierced.

achilles-diatrekhon-aster-lonkhe.line: Challenges one enemy to a sealed one-on-one duel, nobody else allowed in.
achilles-diatrekhon-aster-lonkhe.icon: A long spear planted in the ground at the centre of a ring of light, the ring a duelling arena. A vertical line in a ring. White-gold spear, crimson ring on night. Reads at 24px as: a spear in a circle.
achilles-diatrekhon-aster-lonkhe.lore: Usable once he dismounts from his chariot. It uses the long spear Chiron sent as a wedding gift, and builds a Reality-Marble-like arena for a one-on-one duel with a fellow Heroic Spirit.

achilles-dromeus-kometes.line: On foot, he runs like a comet: moves twice and dodges far better.
achilles-dromeus-kometes.icon: A runner's heel trailing a comet's tail of light. A sweeping arc behind a point. Agility teal tail, white-gold head. Reads at 24px as: a comet streak.
achilles-dromeus-kometes.lore: Embodies the legend that he is the fastest of all heroes, letting him cross a vast battlefield in one breath unhindered. It requires exposing his heel, and is lost if the heel is pierced.

achilles-heel.line: His one weak spot: enemies can aim at his heel for a crippling blow.
achilles-heel.icon: A bare heel pierced by a single arrow, a drop of crimson at the wound. A heel shape crossed by a line. Bone skin, crimson drop. Reads at 24px as: a heel with an arrow.
achilles-heel.lore: His famous fatal weak point. It is the linchpin of Andreias Amarantos and Dromeus Kometes, and when it is pierced both Noble Phantasms disappear.

achilles-runner-comet.line: Bursts into a sprint: regains footing and hits harder and sharper this turn.
achilles-runner-comet.icon: Base: the Comet Form streak. Accent: a spearhead leads the comet, the tail flaring ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a comet with a point.
achilles-runner-comet.lore: The wiki lists Runner Comet as the name of the Noble Phantasm triggered by stepping out of his chariot: the speed of the fastest hero, at the cost of exposing his heel.

achilles-troias-tragoidia.line: His three-horse chariot: rams through foes, at a cost to his Master.
achilles-troias-tragoidia.icon: Three horses charging head-on, a chariot behind them, all trailing a storm. Three heads abreast. Bronze and white, storm-gold dust. Reads at 24px as: three heads in a row.
achilles-troias-tragoidia.lore: His three-horse chariot, two immortal horses from Poseidon and a third taken from a city. He tramples through battle at godspeed, and more speed means more damage.
achilles-troias-tragoidia.look: A three-horse chariot, described at top speed as a giant galloping lawnmower.

anastasia-summer-freezing-summertime.line: Turns untouchable for a moment, her buffs locked in place.
anastasia-summer-freezing-summertime.icon: A sun hat crusted with frost, ice crystals glittering in its brim. A wide brim shape. Ice-white frost on a sun-gold hat. Reads at 24px as: a frosted brim.
anastasia-summer-freezing-summertime.lore: Viy's Mystic Eyes force targets to a halt. Turned on herself, it holds any incoming attack in place for a limited time.

anastasia-summer-ice-block-launcher.line: Hurls a curving ice ball from afar; the farther, the likelier it kills.
anastasia-summer-ice-block-launcher.icon: A baseball-sized lump of ice curving through the air, a frost trail behind it in a hooked arc. A ball on a hook. Ice-white and pale blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a white ball on a curve.
anastasia-summer-ice-block-launcher.lore: She hurls a lump of ice disguised as a snowball with a spin that gives it unlikely force, and Viy's Mystic Eyes bend its flight without slowing it.
anastasia-summer-ice-block-launcher.look: A lump of ice thrown like a snowball that curves in mid-air.

anastasia-summer-ice-bucket-challenge.line: Douses one foe in icy water: they're soaked and may be slowed.
anastasia-summer-ice-bucket-challenge.icon: A tipping bucket pouring a sheet of ice water. A trapezoid tipping, a sheet falling. Ice blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a tipped bucket.

anastasia-summer-rock-snowball.line: Her long snowballs hide rocks and may leave foes bleeding.
anastasia-summer-rock-snowball.icon: A snowball cracked open to show a grey stone inside. A circle with a dark core. White snow, grey rock, a fleck of crimson. Reads at 24px as: a white ball with a dark centre.

anastasia-summer-shvibzik.line: A playful charm: regains luck, hits harder, and readies her ultimate sooner.
anastasia-summer-shvibzik.icon: A small snow-white doll in a sun hat, giggling, snowflakes bouncing around it. A small round figure. White and Luck violet sparkles. Reads at 24px as: a small white doll.
anastasia-summer-shvibzik.lore: The ability to produce and manipulate anything Anastasia considers summery. Such things are often of little use in combat.

anastasia-summer-snegleta.line: A summer snowstorm that weakens armour then crushes all caught in it.
anastasia-summer-snegleta.icon: Hoarfrost drops falling from a sun-bright sky onto a crater of snow. A crater bowl under falling drops. Ice white and sun gold. Reads at 24px as: a white bowl under drops.
anastasia-summer-snegleta.lore: Viy's Mystic Eyes briefly invert the seasons, and the energy that inversion generates is launched at the target.

anastasia-summer-spirit-eyes.line: Viy's eyes open wide: she aims true and lands deadly magic crits.
anastasia-summer-spirit-eyes.icon: A huge eye opening in a wall of ice, its iris a frozen spiral. An almond eye. Pale blue iris, ice-white lid. Reads at 24px as: a blue eye.
anastasia-summer-spirit-eyes.lore: Viy's Mystic Eyes are altered to stay permanently active, creating a maelstrom of surrounding mana that favours Anastasia.

anastasia-summer-swimsuit.line: Beach-ready: water attacks hurt her only half as much.
anastasia-summer-swimsuit.icon: A beach ball with a single wave splash curling over it. A circle under a curl. Sun gold and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a ball under a wave.

anastasia-summer-watermelon.line: Blindfolded, she never misses up close and cuts straight through.
anastasia-summer-watermelon.icon: A watermelon split clean in two by a stick, a blindfold ribbon floating. A split circle. Verdant rind, crimson flesh. Reads at 24px as: a split green circle.

appreciation-of-the-arts.line: An art lover who can learn a nearby artistic ultimate's secrets.
appreciation-of-the-arts.icon: An ornate gilt picture frame with an eye painted inside it. A rectangle around an eye. Gold frame, Luck violet eye. Reads at 24px as: a gold frame with a dot.
appreciation-of-the-arts.lore: Seeing a Noble Phantasm with artistic anecdotes gives Gilles a small chance of working out its True Name.

arjuna-agni-gandiva.line: Looses a flaming arrow from very far away straight at one target.
arjuna-agni-gandiva.icon: A great longbow drawn to full, the nocked arrow wrapped in flame. A tall bow arc with a horizontal line. Ember gold flame, dark bow. Reads at 24px as: a bow with a burning line.
arjuna-agni-gandiva.lore: The longbow Arjuna received from the fire god Agni. It looses flaming arrows that home in with missile precision thanks to his Clairvoyance.
arjuna-agni-gandiva.look: A longbow firing arrows wrapped in flame.

arjuna-awarded-hero.line: The hero's rewards: heals over time and readies his ultimate sooner.
arjuna-awarded-hero.icon: A laurel crown resting on a bow, a soft green glow under it. A ring above an arc. Gold laurel, verdant glow. Reads at 24px as: a gold ring over an arc.
arjuna-awarded-hero.lore: Represents Arjuna's lifelong good fortune: whatever he needs is given to him at the moment he needs it, so long as no active curse stands in the way.

arjuna-clairvoyance-bowman.line: An archer's eye: from range, his shots are much harder to dodge.
arjuna-clairvoyance-bowman.icon: An eye framed by a drawn bowstring, the arrowhead at the pupil. An eye with a line through it. Luck violet iris, gold arrowhead. Reads at 24px as: an eye on a line.
arjuna-clairvoyance-bowman.lore: Superb long-range eyesight that sees past normal vision, even invisible targets. He also bends his own sense of time at the moment he looses an arrow.

arjuna-fated-rivals.line: If Karna is near, the two rivals fight only each other.
arjuna-fated-rivals.icon: Base: two blades crossed, one of white fire and one of gold sun. Accent: Arjuna's blade is the white-blue fire one, held in front. Reads at 24px as: an X of two colours.
arjuna-fated-rivals.lore: Karna was his older half-brother and fated rival, and the thought of him unsettled Arjuna like a mirror. Their enmity peaked at Kurukshetra, and Arjuna remains driven to settle it.

arjuna-mana-burst-flames.line: Pours magic into his strike as flame: harder hit, may burn.
arjuna-mana-burst-flames.icon: Base: an impact burst of fire erupting from a strike. Accent: the fire is the white-blue of Arjuna's flame. Reads at 24px as: a flame burst.
arjuna-mana-burst-flames.lore: A skill that came with Agni Gandiva. It releases jet-like bursts of mana as propulsion for his arrows, so they pierce faster than a rifle shot.

arjuna-pashupata.line: The Destroyer's weapon: wipes an area, and may kill gods outright.
arjuna-pashupata.icon: A raised arm holding a trident-headed missile, a third eye opening behind it. A vertical arm and a three-pronged head. White-blue fire, crimson eye. Reads at 24px as: a trident over an eye.
arjuna-pashupata.lore: A divine weapon given by Shiva that delivers Moksha, which is instant death, with higher Divinity making it likelier. Firing it without restraint would kill Arjuna himself.

arjuna-roar-of-the-flame-god.line: Calls on the fire god: regains luck and hits very hard for a turn.
arjuna-roar-of-the-flame-god.icon: A roaring flame shaped like an open mouth, rising from a bowstring. A flame with a gap. White-blue fire on night. Reads at 24px as: a white flame.
arjuna-roar-of-the-flame-god.lore: In FGO, it is Arjuna's EX skill that raises his own Arts, Buster and NP damage for 3 turns; the wiki gives only game effects.

arturia-avalon-place.line: Places her holy scabbard inside her Master to guard them.
arturia-avalon-place.icon: Base: the Avalon scabbard. Accent: it sinks into an outline of a figure's chest, glowing. Reads at 24px as: a gold sheath entering a figure.
arturia-avalon-place.lore: Avalon is the scabbard of Excalibur: it heals its wielder of any wound and halts aging. Invoked by True Name it raises a barrier that shuts out all physical interference.
arturia-avalon-place.look: A scabbard that deploys a defensive barrier field.

arturia-avalon-retrieve.line: Takes her holy scabbard back from her Master.
arturia-avalon-retrieve.icon: Base: the Avalon scabbard. Accent: it rises out of a figure's chest toward a gauntleted hand. Reads at 24px as: a gold sheath leaving a figure.
arturia-avalon-retrieve.lore: Avalon is the scabbard of Excalibur: it heals its wielder of any wound and halts aging. Invoked by True Name it raises a barrier that shuts out all physical interference.
arturia-avalon-retrieve.look: A scabbard that deploys a defensive barrier field.

arturia-avalon.line: The everdistant utopia: an untouchable barrier, or a Master who heals.
arturia-avalon.icon: Base: the Avalon scabbard. Accent: it unfolds into a barrier of countless gold-white petals, blue enamel at their roots. Reads at 24px as: a gold sheath in a petal ring.
arturia-avalon.lore: The scabbard of Excalibur: it heals any wound and stops aging. Invoked by True Name it raises a Bounded Field that places the user in the land of the fairies, shutting out all physical interference.
arturia-avalon.look: A scabbard that deploys a defensive barrier field.

arturia-charisma.line: A king's presence: allies near her deal more damage.
arturia-charisma.icon: A gold crown with a single raised banner behind it. A crown under a vertical flag. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold crown.
arturia-charisma.lore: An innate talent for commanding an army that raises the morale and abilities of the forces under her command.

arturia-dragons-reactor-core.line: Her dragon heart roars: a huge surge in damage for a moment.
arturia-dragons-reactor-core.icon: A glowing heart-shaped reactor of dragon scales pulsing with blue-white light. A rounded diamond with a core. White-gold core, guard blue scales. Reads at 24px as: a bright core in a diamond.
arturia-dragons-reactor-core.lore: Listed as the Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Mana Burst, which pours mana into her weapon and body and releases it in an instant burst.
arturia-dragons-reactor-core.look: Mana Burst is described as filling the area with light and surging through the weapon.

arturia-excalibur.line: The sword of promised victory: a great beam of light down a line.
arturia-excalibur.icon: A longsword raised high, a column of golden light pouring from its tip. A vertical blade under a beam. White-gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a blade under a gold column.
arturia-excalibur.lore: The holy sword that converts the wielder's mana into light and discharges it from the blade like a beam, destroying everything in its path.
arturia-excalibur.look: A sword of light that fires a massive beam from its tip.

arturia-instinct.line: Sharp instinct: often dodges attacks before they land.
arturia-instinct.icon: A single eye closed, a bright line of foresight crossing in front of it. A closed lid and a line. Agility teal line, bone ink lid. Reads at 24px as: a closed eye and a slash.
arturia-instinct.lore: A sixth sense close to precognition that picks the best course of action in combat, predicts projectile paths, and ignores sight and sound interference.

arturia-invisible-air.line: Wind hides her sword: harder to read and to dodge while it lasts.
arturia-invisible-air.icon: Base: a sword wrapped in swirling wind, its blade invisible, only the hilt seen. Accent: Arturia's hilt is gold and blue. Reads at 24px as: a hilt in a swirl.
arturia-invisible-air.lore: A barrier of layered wind that bends light around her sword, hiding its length and path. The compressed wind can be released as a one-shot projectile.
arturia-invisible-air.look: The sword is wrapped in whirring wind that refracts light, rendering it nearly invisible.

arturia-knight-of-utopia.line: Rallies allies around her to hit harder for a turn.
arturia-knight-of-utopia.icon: A raised sword crossed with a banner bearing a red dragon. A vertical blade beside a flag. Gold, white and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a blade and a flag.
arturia-knight-of-utopia.lore: Listed as the Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Charisma, her gift for leading armies.

arturia-mana-burst.line: Pours magic into a strike: a much heavier blow.
arturia-mana-burst.icon: Base: an impact burst of mana erupting from a strike. Accent: Arturia's burst is blue-white with a gold rim. Reads at 24px as: a white burst.
arturia-mana-burst.lore: Infuses mana into the weapon and body, then releases it at once for reinforcement, sword technique, defence and movement.
arturia-mana-burst.look: It fills the area with light and makes the weapon surge with energy.

arturia-radiant-road.line: Lights the way: allies crit more and her ultimate comes sooner.
arturia-radiant-road.icon: A shining road of light leading to a distant gold star. A tapering path to a point. White-gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold path.
arturia-radiant-road.lore: In FGO, it is Artoria's EX skill, the upgrade of Instinct, that charges her NP gauge and gains critical stars.

arturia-strike-air.line: Unleashes the wind around her sword as a single crushing gust.
arturia-strike-air.icon: Base: the wind-wrapped hilt. Accent: the wind bursts forward as a hammer-shaped gust. Reads at 24px as: a hilt firing a swirl.
arturia-strike-air.lore: The release of the compressed wind stored in Invisible Air as a forward projectile, called the Hammer of the Wind King.
arturia-strike-air.look: A violent gale of compressed wind unleashed forward.

arturia-vivians-blessing.line: The Lady of the Lake's blessing: water never hinders her.
arturia-vivians-blessing.icon: Base: a hand rising from still water. Accent: on Saber it holds a sword, on Lancer a lance. Reads at 24px as: a hand above a line.

asterios-avyssos-of-labrys.line: His twin axes: wild crits and bleeding wounds for a turn.
asterios-avyssos-of-labrys.icon: Two huge double-headed axes crossed, their edges notched. An X with two big heads. Iron grey, crimson notches. Reads at 24px as: an X with broad ends.
asterios-avyssos-of-labrys.lore: Refers to the pair of giant axes Asterios wields, a symbol of the Labyrinth and the origin of the word. The original double-headed axe was rearranged into two separate axes.

asterios-chaos-labyrinthos.line: Traps foes in his labyrinth, where they are weakened and lost.
asterios-chaos-labyrinthos.icon: A square maze seen from above, a single bull's horn at its centre. A square of nested paths. Bone ink walls on night, crimson centre. Reads at 24px as: a nested square.
asterios-chaos-labyrinthos.lore: The Labyrinth that confined him in life, manifested as a greater magecraft near a Reality Marble. It stays until he falls or all his foes die, and its layout never changes.

asterios-monstrous-strength.line: Brute force: one strike's physical damage doubles.
asterios-monstrous-strength.icon: A monstrous fist shattering stone. A fist over cracks. Iron and ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a fist in a burst.
asterios-monstrous-strength.lore: A trait of monsters and Magical Beasts that temporarily raises Strength by a rank, for a duration set by the skill's rank.

asterios-natural-monster.line: A born monster: shrugs off weakening and takes much less damage.
asterios-natural-monster.icon: A bull's horned skull crowned with dark fire. A wide horned shape. Bone and crimson-black. Reads at 24px as: a horned shape.
asterios-natural-monster.lore: Given to those born monsters rather than fallen heroes or gods, it is the source of his inhuman Strength and Endurance.

avalon-master.line: The Master's holy scabbard soaks most of an attack and wipes its curses.
avalon-master.icon: A gold scabbard set with blue enamel, standing upright and crowned by a halo of overlapping petals of light. A tall narrow sheath shape. White-gold light on night, blue enamel the only cool note. Reads at 24px as: an upright gold sheath with a pale halo.
avalon-master.lore: Avalon is the hallowed scabbard of Excalibur and the embodiment of the utopia King Arthur seeks, stolen from her before the Battle of Camlann.
avalon-master.look: A luxurious gold scabbard with blue enamel, more crown-like than weapon-like.

avalon-pass.line: Hands the holy scabbard to an allied Master standing right beside you.
avalon-pass.icon: Base: the Avalon scabbard, laid horizontal. Accent: two open hands under it, one giving and one receiving. A horizontal bar over two cupped shapes. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold bar held between two hands.
avalon-pass.lore: Avalon is the hallowed scabbard of Excalibur and the embodiment of the utopia King Arthur seeks; passing it to a Master is this game's own mechanic.
avalon-pass.look: A luxurious gold scabbard with blue enamel, more crown-like than weapon-like.

avalon.line: A relic carried by the Master: more life, stronger blows, and wounds that close themselves.
avalon.icon: Base: the Avalon scabbard, upright and alone, without its halo. Gold and blue enamel, faint green motes rising off it for the healing. Reads at 24px as: an upright gold sheath.
avalon.lore: Avalon is the hallowed scabbard of Excalibur and the embodiment of the utopia King Arthur seeks, stolen from her before the Battle of Camlann.
avalon.look: A luxurious gold scabbard with blue enamel, more crown-like than weapon-like.

basmu-cursed-poison-dragonfire.line: The horned serpent breathes poison over the ground before it.
basmu-cursed-poison-dragonfire.icon: A horned serpent's head breathing a cone of violet flame. A head and a widening cone. Violet poison fire on night. Reads at 24px as: a violet cone.
basmu-cursed-poison-dragonfire.lore: Bašmu, a horned dragon-serpent born of Tiamat, can breathe poison that would have killed Mordred instantly had a Command Spell not saved her.
basmu-cursed-poison-dragonfire.look: A large venomous horned snake with two forelegs breathing poison.

charisma.line: A leader's presence: allies nearby deal more damage.
charisma.icon: A gold crown with a single raised banner behind it. A crown under a vertical flag. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold crown.
charisma.lore: The natural gift for commanding an army, raising the abilities of allies in group battles; at Rank B it is enough to rule a whole country.

chiron-antares-snipe.line: At night, a starlight arrow strips one foe's defences and strikes.
chiron-antares-snipe.icon: A single star in the scorpion constellation loosed as a shining arrow. A star with a long tail. White-gold on starry night. Reads at 24px as: a shooting star.
chiron-antares-snipe.lore: A tracking sniping Noble Phantasm that fires a shining star and needs no True Name or mana to start. It lacks power, so it must kill in one shot; it fires on its own a turn after his death and recharges only the next night.
chiron-antares-snipe.look: A shining star shot as an arrow.

chiron-clairvoyance.line: Far-sight: shots from range are much harder to dodge.
chiron-clairvoyance.icon: An eye glowing with a star in its pupil. An almond with a spark. Luck violet glow. Reads at 24px as: an eye with a star.
chiron-clairvoyance.lore: Good eyesight that tracks distant targets by improving moving-target vision. Paired with his Eye of the Mind it gives limited glimpses of the future.
chiron-clairvoyance.look: A glow around his eyes when used in the Siegfried and Frankenstein fight against Achilles and Atalanta.

chiron-consecration-of-eternal-life.line: Blesses nearby allies: they crit more often and harder.
chiron-consecration-of-eternal-life.icon: A centaur's hand raising a laurel wreath over a group, gold light spreading. A ring over an arc. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold wreath.
chiron-consecration-of-eternal-life.lore: Recalls the legend of Chiron offering up his immortality and being raised to the heavens as the constellation Sagittarius, a protector of people against the Scorpion. In FGO, it raises party critical damage and gains stars, with a self-damage risk.

chiron-eye-of-the-mind-true.line: Battle-honed insight: dodges better and recovers the skill as he does.
chiron-eye-of-the-mind-true.icon: A calm eye with lines of motion bending away from it. An eye in parting lines. Agility teal on night. Reads at 24px as: an eye with curved lines.
chiron-eye-of-the-mind-true.lore: Insight born of training: he calmly reads the opponent and his own predicament, and reasons a way out through combat.

chiron-great-sage-of-centaurs.line: Shifts between man and centaur: faster, but easier to hit.
chiron-great-sage-of-centaurs.icon: A centaur's silhouette mid-gallop, a bow on its back. A four-legged figure with a torso. Bone ink with gold light. Reads at 24px as: a centaur silhouette.

chiron-wisdom-of-divine-gift.line: The great teacher copies three skills from other heroes in the battle.
chiron-wisdom-of-divine-gift.icon: An open scroll with three glowing seals copied onto it. A scroll with three marks. Bone parchment, gold seals. Reads at 24px as: a scroll with three dots.
chiron-wisdom-of-divine-gift.lore: The many kinds of wisdom granted by the Greek gods, letting him show almost any skill of B to A rank. With his Master's permission he can also grant skills to other Servants.

chiron-wisdom-teach.line: Teaches one of his copied skills to an ally beside him.
chiron-wisdom-teach.icon: Base: the three-seal scroll. Accent: one seal lifts off it toward an open hand. Reads at 24px as: a scroll and a dot rising.
chiron-wisdom-teach.lore: The same Wisdom of Divine Gift: he can bestow skills on other Servants with his Master's permission.

cu-ansuz.line: Draws a fire rune that blasts a foe and may set them burning.
cu-ansuz.icon: The rune Ansuz traced in fire, burning in the air. An angular F-shaped glyph. Ember flame on night. Reads at 24px as: a burning rune.
cu-ansuz.lore: Ansuz is one of four runes (Algiz, Nauthiz, Ansuz, Ingwaz) carved in the seal of his four-branch arena. The page describes rune magecraft generally, not Ansuz's fire effect.
cu-ansuz.look: Runes carved into the ground, on stones or on his armor.

cu-gae-bolg-barbed-spear.line: A cursed spear that strikes the heart first; the unlucky die outright.
cu-gae-bolg-barbed-spear.icon: A crimson spear curving back on itself, its barb already at a heart. A curved line ending at a dot. Crimson spear on night. Reads at 24px as: a red hook.
cu-gae-bolg-barbed-spear.lore: A melee technique where causality is reversed, so the heart is pierced before the thrust lands.

cu-gae-bolg-soaring-spear.line: Hurls the cursed spear skyward to rain down on a wide area.
cu-gae-bolg-soaring-spear.icon: A crimson spear thrown high, splitting into a fan of darts as it falls. A point bursting into many lines. Crimson on night. Reads at 24px as: a red fan of lines.
cu-gae-bolg-soaring-spear.lore: His strongest attack: the spear is hurled from the sky into the ground like carpet bombing, striking enemies and their surroundings.
cu-gae-bolg-soaring-spear.look: A two-meter crimson spear thrown from the sky that splits into many darts.

cu-protection-from-arrows.line: Arrows and bullets from front or side simply miss him.
cu-protection-from-arrows.icon: A shower of arrows bending away around a lone figure's outline. Curved lines around a silhouette. Agility teal on night. Reads at 24px as: a figure in parting lines.
cu-protection-from-arrows.lore: A special ability to avoid projectiles as long as he sees the attacker, or by reading murderous intent and the sound of cutting air.
cu-protection-from-arrows.look: Shown as him avoiding unseen thrown weapons and projectiles.

cu-rune-magic.line: Casts a random rune blessing, then picks one more of his choice.
cu-rune-magic.icon: A ring of carved Norse runes on standing stones, one glowing. A ring of marks with one bright. Mana blue on grey stone. Reads at 24px as: a ring of marks.
cu-rune-magic.lore: Northern European magecraft that engraves words of power into stone or objects to cause effects, search, set fires or build Bounded Fields.
cu-rune-magic.look: Runes engraved on his armor, stones or the ground.

cu-shoal-of-four-branches.line: Carves four runes into the ground: survives one killing blow and hits harder.
cu-shoal-of-four-branches.icon: A spear point pressed to the ground, four runes glowing in a square around it. A vertical line over four marks. Crimson spear, Mana-blue runes. Reads at 24px as: a line over a square of dots.
cu-shoal-of-four-branches.lore: Ath nGabla, an arena of four branches that guarantees one-on-one combat with no retreat.
cu-shoal-of-four-branches.look: A seal made by pointing his spear at the ground and carving four runes.

danzo-dongyu-concealment.line: Wraps nearby allies in a storm that hides them from sight.
danzo-dongyu-concealment.icon: Base: a swirling vortex of black wind with a bull's horns. Accent: the vortex closes inward around shadow figures, hiding them. Reads at 24px as: a closed dark swirl.
danzo-dongyu-concealment.lore: Mechanical Illusionary Method - Bull Swallowing: a technique built on the Otogi Houko tale of swallowing a bull, which draws the target in and crushes it by compression; a Mystic Code from Kashin Koji gives it demon-slaying properties.
danzo-dongyu-concealment.look: It produces a vacuum blade that draws the target in and compresses it to pulp.

danzo-dongyu-storm.line: Unleashes a vacuum storm down a line that crushes what it catches.
danzo-dongyu-storm.icon: Base: the black-wind vortex with bull's horns. Accent: it opens into a straight tunnel of wind blades. Reads at 24px as: a swirl firing a line.
danzo-dongyu-storm.lore: Mechanical Illusionary Method - Bull Swallowing: a technique built on the Otogi Houko tale of swallowing a bull, which draws the target in and crushes it by compression; a Mystic Code from Kashin Koji gives it demon-slaying properties.
danzo-dongyu-storm.look: It produces a vacuum blade that draws the target in and compresses it to pulp.

danzo-fubatsu.line: Makes an ally untouchable for a few hits and sharpens their crits.
danzo-fubatsu.icon: A clockwork shield-plate unfolding in front of a figure, its gears visible. A fan of plates. Brass and guard blue. Reads at 24px as: a fan of plates.
danzo-fubatsu.lore: A Karakuri Genpo (mechanical illusion) technique, 'Steadfast', of Kato Danzo, whose body is man-made wooden machinery (mode of Karakuri Genpo). In FGO, Karakuri Genpo grants one ally Invincibility for 1 turn and raises their star generation; the wiki gives no lore text.

danzo-funshindan.line: Throws fire-bombs at an area that may set foes burning.
danzo-funshindan.icon: A ninja smoke-bomb bursting into flame mid-air. A ball and a burst. Ember fire on night. Reads at 24px as: a fiery burst.

danzo-harisenbon.line: A thousand needles: disables or slows one nearby foe.
danzo-harisenbon.icon: A spray of thin silver needles fanning outward. Many fine lines from a point. Steel on night. Reads at 24px as: a fan of thin lines.
danzo-harisenbon.lore: A Ninjutsu technique (mode of Ninjutsu), the general term for ninja intelligence, combat, thieving and torture arts using the Fuma party system. In FGO, Ninjutsu grants one ally Evasion and extra stars.

danzo-kawarimi.line: Swaps places with another unit to dodge an attack.
danzo-kawarimi.icon: A log in a cut cloak where a figure stood, the figure reappearing beside it. A log beside an outline. Wood and teal. Reads at 24px as: a log and a figure.
danzo-kawarimi.lore: A Karakuri Genpo (mechanical illusion) technique, 'Substitution', of Kato Danzo, whose body is man-made wooden machinery (mode of Karakuri Genpo). In FGO, Karakuri Genpo grants one ally Invincibility for 1 turn and raises their star generation; the wiki gives no lore text.

danzo-kirihanasu.line: Sheds a doll part to survive a fatal blow in secret.
danzo-kirihanasu.icon: A doll's detached arm falling away, joints and gears showing. A limb with a gear. Porcelain and brass. Reads at 24px as: a falling limb.
danzo-kirihanasu.lore: A Karakuri Genpo (mechanical illusion) technique, 'Detachment', of Kato Danzo, whose body is man-made wooden machinery (mode of Karakuri Genpo). In FGO, Karakuri Genpo grants one ally Invincibility for 1 turn and raises their star generation; the wiki gives no lore text.

danzo-subversive-activities.line: Sabotage: weakens the attacks of foes in front of her.
danzo-subversive-activities.icon: A dagger cutting a rope that holds a banner. A blade crossing a line. Steel and ink. Reads at 24px as: a blade cutting a line.

danzo-synthetic-limbs.line: Her doll body won't bleed; she regains footing and hits harder.
danzo-synthetic-limbs.icon: A karakuri doll's jointed hand closing into a fist. A segmented hand. Porcelain white and brass. Reads at 24px as: a jointed fist.
danzo-synthetic-limbs.lore: Her flesh has been replaced by man-made karakuri machinery, which adds bonuses to combat and success checks; at A Rank the whole body, not just the limbs, is an artificial doll.

danzo-tobikato.line: Kite technique: an ally dodges several attacks and crits more.
danzo-tobikato.icon: A paper kite with a ninja shadow riding it. A diamond kite with a tail. Bone and teal. Reads at 24px as: a diamond with a tail.
danzo-tobikato.lore: A Ninjutsu technique (mode of Ninjutsu), the general term for ninja intelligence, combat, thieving and torture arts using the Fuma party system. In FGO, Ninjutsu grants one ally Evasion and extra stars.

danzo-yuugao.line: Costs a Command Seal: a single cut that kills one target outright.
danzo-yuugao.icon: A moonflower bloom severed cleanly at its stem, one petal falling. A flower over a cut line. White petals, crimson cut. Reads at 24px as: a white bloom over a red line.
danzo-yuugao.lore: Black Arts Decapitation Method - Moonflower is Danzo's second Noble Phantasm, a murderous technique she dislikes and basically does not use in FGO.

dioscuri-guardians-of-navigation.line: The twin stars guide nearby allies: stronger ultimates and better defence.
dioscuri-guardians-of-navigation.icon: Base: two stars side by side above a ship's prow. Accent: Castor's star burns gold, Pollux's silver. Reads at 24px as: two stars over a curve.
dioscuri-guardians-of-navigation.lore: Calls protection for those who sail the seas. The Divine Twins give hope to those in danger and energize them to their souls; it is a composite of Charisma and Tactics.

dioscuri-mana-burst-castor.line: Releases magic as St. Elmo's fire: recovers footing, then strikes much harder.
dioscuri-mana-burst-castor.icon: Base: an impact burst of mana from a strike. Accent: Castor's burst is the pale blue flicker of St. Elmo's fire. Reads at 24px as: a pale blue burst.
dioscuri-mana-burst-castor.lore: Shows the twins as the light that guides ships, St. Elmo's fire. It releases mana as strength-boosting light.
dioscuri-mana-burst-castor.look: Mana released as light (St. Elmo's fire).

dioscuri-mana-burst-pollux.line: Releases magic as St. Elmo's fire: recovers footing, then strikes much harder.
dioscuri-mana-burst-pollux.icon: Base: an impact burst of mana from a strike. Accent: Pollux's burst is a silver-white flicker of St. Elmo's fire. Reads at 24px as: a silver burst.
dioscuri-mana-burst-pollux.lore: A skill expressing the twins as the light guiding sailors, St. Elmo's fire; it releases magical energy as strength-boosting light, akin to the Mana Burst some saint-type Servants have.
dioscuri-mana-burst-pollux.look: Magical energy released as a strengthening light, in the manner of St. Elmo's fire.

dioscuri-stars-of-the-chief-god.line: The twins share Zeus's blessing, each boosting the other's attacks.
dioscuri-stars-of-the-chief-god.icon: Base: two stars joined by a thread of lightning. Accent: the Castor star leads, the Pollux star follows. Reads at 24px as: two stars on a zigzag.
dioscuri-stars-of-the-chief-god.lore: Expresses the Divine Twins existing as one and becoming a constellation.

dioscuri-twin-gods-divine-core-castor.line: A divine core: every hit is stronger, and the ultimate may come sooner.
dioscuri-twin-gods-divine-core-castor.icon: A glowing star-core held in a cupped gauntlet, rays leaking between the fingers. A bright point in a curve. White-gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a bright dot in a cup.
dioscuri-twin-gods-divine-core-castor.lore: A skill both twins hold. Once A rank for ancient divine twins, it fell to B as Greek legends grew, notably Castor's tale of being the one without divine blood.

dioscuri-twin-gods-divine-core-pollux.line: A divine core: every hit is stronger and crits a little more.
dioscuri-twin-gods-divine-core-pollux.icon: Base: a star-core held in a cupped gauntlet. Accent: Pollux's core is silver. Reads at 24px as: a silver dot in a cup.
dioscuri-twin-gods-divine-core-pollux.lore: Both twins hold this skill as ancient divine twins; it should have been A rank but fell to B as Greek legends shifted, notably the tale of Castor lacking divine blood.

dioscuri-tyndaridae.line: Standing together, the divine twins strike as one.
dioscuri-tyndaridae.icon: Base: two blades crossed at the tip under a pair of stars. Accent: one blade gold, one silver. Reads at 24px as: a gold-and-silver X under two dots.
dioscuri-tyndaridae.lore: The Dioscuri's main Noble Phantasm. The wiki gives no further detail.

disengage.line: Cancels an attack, slips away, and recovers a little.
disengage.icon: A figure stepping back out of a blade's arc, a faint green glow on them. A silhouette leaving a curve. Agility teal, a verdant glint. Reads at 24px as: a figure beside an arc.
disengage.lore: The ability to withdraw from battle or reset the state around oneself, restoring technique conditions to starting values and shaking off some status ailments.

drake-beyond-the-uncharted.line: Charts the unknown: allies near her or aboard hit harder with ultimates.
drake-beyond-the-uncharted.icon: An old sea chart with its edge torn off, a compass rose glowing beyond the tear. A rectangle with a star past its edge. Bone parchment, gold rose. Reads at 24px as: a torn sheet with a star.
drake-beyond-the-uncharted.lore: In FGO, it is the A-rank upgrade of Voyager of the Storm, raising party attack, NP damage and NP gain for 3 turns; the wiki gives no lore text.

drake-blazing-golden-rule.line: Each critical hit brings her ultimate closer and maybe a stolen galleon.
drake-blazing-golden-rule.icon: A burning gold doubloon flipping in the air. A coin with flames. Gold on night, ember edge. Reads at 24px as: a burning coin.
drake-blazing-golden-rule.lore: In FGO, Drake's Golden Rule (B) and Golden Rule of Running Through (A) raise her NP gain, and the A version adds Buster up and Ignore Defense; the wiki gives no lore text.

drake-golden-hind-wild-hunt.line: Summons her flagship: she and allies aboard can't be targeted.
drake-golden-hind-wild-hunt.icon: The Golden Hind's bow cutting through a storm, its gilded figurehead forward. A ship's prow in profile. Gold hull on storm night. Reads at 24px as: a gold prow.
drake-golden-hind-wild-hunt.lore: Her flagship Golden Hind leads a vast flotilla of smaller craft that fans out and destroys enemies with overwhelming firepower. It carries traces of the fleet that beat the Spanish Armada and of the golden stag and storm legends.
drake-golden-hind-wild-hunt.look: A flagship at the head of a vast flotilla of smaller ships.

drake-golden-wild-hunt.line: Her fleet fires a broadside down a long stretch of the field.
drake-golden-wild-hunt.icon: A row of cannon flashes along a ship's side, smoke rolling. A line of bright dots on a hull. Ember flashes on night. Reads at 24px as: a row of flashes.
drake-golden-wild-hunt.lore: Her flagship Golden Hind leads a vast flotilla of smaller craft that fans out and destroys enemies with overwhelming firepower. It carries traces of the fleet that beat the Spanish Armada and of the golden stag and storm legends.
drake-golden-wild-hunt.look: A flagship at the head of a vast flotilla of smaller ships.

drake-pioneer-of-the-stars.line: The great navigator: readies her ultimate, pierces defences, rallies crits.
drake-pioneer-of-the-stars.icon: A ship's wheel with a star in its hub, the spokes catching light. A spoked wheel. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold wheel.
drake-pioneer-of-the-stars.lore: A unique skill of heroes who became turning points in human history; it turns impossible voyages and challenges into achievable events.

drake-voyager-of-the-storm.line: A storm sailor at home aboard the Golden Hind.
drake-voyager-of-the-storm.icon: A tricorne hat in a lashing gale, rain streaking. A hat shape in diagonal lines. Gold trim, storm blue. Reads at 24px as: a hat in streaks.
drake-voyager-of-the-storm.lore: Skill at sailing vessels recognised as ships, and since it needs leadership it also combines Charisma and Tactics.

emiya-caladbolg.line: Fires a twisted spiral sword as an arrow that tears through an area.
emiya-caladbolg.icon: A spiralling drill-like sword-arrow leaving a corkscrew of light. A twisted spike. Mana blue and white on night. Reads at 24px as: a spiral spike.
emiya-caladbolg.lore: The legendary Irish sword Caladbolg, projected and reshaped into an arrow, then fired as a Broken Phantasm.
emiya-caladbolg.look: A spiraling twisted sword-arrow fired from a bow.

emiya-clairvoyance.line: An archer's far-sight: long shots are much harder to dodge.
emiya-clairvoyance.icon: An eye glowing with a star in its pupil. An almond with a spark. Luck violet glow. Reads at 24px as: an eye with a star.
emiya-clairvoyance.lore: Improves static and moving-target vision, giving bow accuracy at ultra long range against fast targets within about four kilometers.

emiya-eye-of-the-mind-true-ex.line: When near death, his honed instincts let him dodge and endure.
emiya-eye-of-the-mind-true-ex.icon: Base: the calm eye in parting lines. Accent: a crack of crimson light at its corner, for the last stand. Reads at 24px as: an eye with a red mark.
emiya-eye-of-the-mind-true-ex.lore: A danger-avoidance sense won by hard combat, which calmly judges the enemy and his predicament and finds a comeback if even a 1% chance exists. It rises to EX in its upgrade.
emiya-eye-of-the-mind-true-ex.look: Shown as tactical evasion, such as dodging Cú Chulainn's attacks.

emiya-eye-of-the-mind-true.line: Battle-honed insight: dodges better and recovers the skill as he does.
emiya-eye-of-the-mind-true.icon: A calm eye with lines of motion bending away from it. An eye in parting lines. Agility teal on night. Reads at 24px as: an eye with curved lines.
emiya-eye-of-the-mind-true.lore: A danger-avoidance sense won by hard combat, which calmly judges the enemy and his predicament and finds a comeback if even a 1% chance exists.
emiya-eye-of-the-mind-true.look: Shown as tactical evasion, such as dodging Cú Chulainn's attacks.

emiya-hawkeye.line: Hawk-like sight: long-range shots crit often and hard.
emiya-hawkeye.icon: A hawk's eye, sharp and gold-ringed, a crosshair in the pupil. An eye with a cross. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold eye.
emiya-hawkeye.lore: The page lists Hawk Eye as the Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Clairvoyance, his long-range vision skill.

emiya-hrunting.line: A sword-arrow that chases its target and won't miss.
emiya-hrunting.icon: A crimson hound-like streak of light hooking around to its target. A curved red trail. Crimson on night. Reads at 24px as: a red curling trail.
emiya-hrunting.lore: A tracking mystic sword fired as an arrow that can pursue targets over long distances.
emiya-hrunting.look: A sword used as an arrow for sniper shots.

emiya-kanshou-and-bakuya.line: His twin short swords: better magic defence in close fighting.
emiya-kanshou-and-bakuya.icon: Two short curved swords, one black and one white, crossed. A small X. Black and white with gold. Reads at 24px as: a black-and-white X.
emiya-kanshou-and-bakuya.lore: The paired yin-yang swords of Chinese legend, his favourite melee weapons, which improve magic and physical resistance when held.
emiya-kanshou-and-bakuya.look: A pair of short Chinese-style swords with distinct patterns.

emiya-magecraft.line: Can cast spells, and each one extends his reach.
emiya-magecraft.icon: A magic circle forming in an open palm. A ring above a hand. Mana blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue ring.
emiya-magecraft.lore: Orthodox magecraft of unremarkable spells learned in life, including reinforcement and structural analysis.

emiya-overedge.line: The twin swords grow into wings: two strong strikes in a row.
emiya-overedge.icon: Base: the black-and-white twin swords. Accent: their blades lengthen into wing-like edges. Reads at 24px as: a winged X.
emiya-overedge.lore: Kanshou and Bakuya are the paired swords EMIYA habitually projects. In FGO his projection magecraft can make projected Noble Phantasms explode, momentarily raising their destructive power (Overedge).

emiya-projection-magic.line: The magic that copies weapons; silenced, he can't use it.
emiya-projection-magic.icon: A sword half-drawn in glowing wireframe, its circuits lit. A blade in outline. Mana blue lines on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue wire blade.
emiya-projection-magic.lore: Magic that reproduces tools from his mental image for several minutes, rising sharply in rank for swords. It lets him prepare counterfeits and detonate them as Broken Phantasms.
emiya-projection-magic.look: Shown as swords and dual blades such as Kanshou and Bakuya being generated.

emiya-reinforcement.line: Strengthens his weapon by magic for one fight.
emiya-reinforcement.icon: A blade with blue circuit lines running along it. A blade with a glow. Mana blue on steel. Reads at 24px as: a blade with blue lines.
emiya-reinforcement.lore: Magic that analyses an item's structure to find its flaw and repair or strengthen it.

emiya-rho-aias.line: Raises a seven-petal flower shield that blocks an ultimate attack.
emiya-rho-aias.icon: Seven translucent pink petals opening in front of a hand. A rose of overlapping panes. Pink light on night. Reads at 24px as: a pink flower.
emiya-rho-aias.lore: The shield of Aias, an absolute defence against projectile weapons that takes heavy mana to manifest in layers.
emiya-rho-aias.look: Translucent pink flower-like petals that block attacks.

emiya-trace-on.line: Copies a weapon for a chosen boost, at a growing cost to himself.
emiya-trace-on.icon: Circuit lines lighting up a forearm as a blade forms in the hand. A diagonal arm ending in a blade. Mana blue and gold. Reads at 24px as: a blue line ending in a blade.
emiya-trace-on.lore: The page lists Trace On as the EX Circuit Connection upgrade of his projection magecraft, where his magical circuits link to replicate blades.
emiya-trace-on.look: Shown as magical circuits connecting as blades are replicated.

emiya-tracing.line: Recharges his copied weapons and sharpens the next one.
emiya-tracing.icon: Two hourglasses with sword-shaped sands. Two upright shapes. Mana blue and gold. Reads at 24px as: two hourglasses.
emiya-tracing.lore: Duplicating a weapon down to its components almost perfectly while reading the wielder's skill.

emiya-unlimited-blade-works.line: Chants a reality of endless swords that rain down on the field.
emiya-unlimited-blade-works.icon: A wasteland of countless swords planted in the ground under giant gears in a red sky. Many vertical lines under a gear. Crimson sky, steel swords. Reads at 24px as: a field of spikes under a gear.
emiya-unlimited-blade-works.lore: An Innate Bounded Field (Reality Marble) that stores thousands of weapons, mostly copied Noble Phantasms he has seen, to wield or fire in barrages.
emiya-unlimited-blade-works.look: A steel-mill world of weapons, flames and giant gears.

fae-contract.line: A fairy's contract: lands curses more often and resists them better.
fae-contract.icon: A tiny contract scroll sealed with a frost-flower seal, fairy dust around it. A small scroll with a seal. Ice white and Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: a small sealed scroll.
fae-contract.lore: Anastasia's contract with Viy; contracts for wearing swimsuits are handled separately.

gilles-blasphemy-aesthetic.line: His profane art weakens the ultimates of foes before him.
gilles-blasphemy-aesthetic.icon: An inverted holy icon smeared with dark paint. A cross upside down. Violet and crimson on night. Reads at 24px as: an inverted cross.
gilles-blasphemy-aesthetic.lore: The page lists Appreciation of Blasphemy as the Grand Order upgrade of his Appreciation of the Arts.

gilles-evil-gaze-of-the-abyss.line: A gaze from the abyss terrifies foes in front of him.
gilles-evil-gaze-of-the-abyss.icon: Bulging eyes opening in a black void. Two round eyes in darkness. Violet-white eyes on night. Reads at 24px as: two eyes in black.
gilles-evil-gaze-of-the-abyss.lore: His eyes changed after he looked into the abyss and it looked back, becoming a source of fear that brings the target's own fear of the unknown to the surface.

gilles-gigantic-horror.line: At death's door, he becomes the heart of a colossal horror.
gilles-gigantic-horror.icon: A towering mass of tentacles with a small figure at its core. A mound of curling lines. Violet-black, a crimson core. Reads at 24px as: a mass of tendrils.
gilles-gigantic-horror.lore: A massive evil god from another world, his strongest summon, with huge size and regeneration that withstands several Noble Phantasms.
gilles-gigantic-horror.look: A massive Lovecraftian beast with Gilles at its center.

gilles-item-construction.icon: A round alchemist's flask with a glowing liquid and a small gear stamped on the glass. A round-bottomed flask. Verdant liquid in smoked glass on violet night. Reads at 24px as: a round green flask.
gilles-item-construction.lore: Gilles lost this class skill in exchange for gaining his summoning ability through his Noble Phantasm.

gilles-prelatis-spellbook.line: His living spellbook: the source of his spells, which can take hits for him.
gilles-prelatis-spellbook.icon: Base: a thick spellbook bound in pale leather, tentacles curling from its pages. Accent: as Caster it floats open in his hand. Reads at 24px as: an open book with curls.
gilles-prelatis-spellbook.lore: A grimoire bound in human skin that serves as a vast mana reserve, letting Gilles cast great sorcery regardless of his aptitude and summon endless water demons from another world.
gilles-prelatis-spellbook.look: A book bound in human skin.

gilles-saber-holy-maidens-side.line: Beside his saint: readies his ultimate, or rages if madness took him.
gilles-saber-holy-maidens-side.icon: A white lily before a fleur-de-lis banner. A flower and a flag. White and gold. Reads at 24px as: a white lily.
gilles-saber-holy-maidens-side.lore: The page lists By The Holy Maiden's Side as the Grand Order upgrade of Golden Rule, with no further detail.

gilles-saber-military-tactics.line: A marshal's tactics: allies near him win army-scale clashes.
gilles-saber-military-tactics.icon: A field map with arrows sweeping around a block of troops. Arrows curving around a rectangle. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: arrows around a block.
gilles-saber-military-tactics.lore: Merit gained as Jeanne d'Arc's assistant, giving a particular bonus when under attack like a siege.

gilles-saber-prelatis-encouragement.line: A dark whisper: much stronger, but he may fall into madness.
gilles-saber-prelatis-encouragement.icon: A pale hand on a knight's shoulder, violet mist curling from its fingers. A hand shape over a pauldron. Violet on steel. Reads at 24px as: a hand with mist.
gilles-saber-prelatis-encouragement.lore: Encouragement from Prelati that strengthens his STR through magecraft, at the cost that memories of his life after Jeanne's death become clearer.

gilles-saber-prelatis-spellbook.line: In madness, he can use the spellbook's summoning spells.
gilles-saber-prelatis-spellbook.icon: Base: the pale-leather spellbook with tentacles. Accent: as Saber it is chained to his sword hilt. Reads at 24px as: a book on a blade.
gilles-saber-prelatis-spellbook.lore: He also owns Prelati's Spellbook, but using it transforms him automatically into his Caster version.

gilles-saber-saint-war-order.line: Raises the holy banner: he hits far harder and allies crit more.
gilles-saber-saint-war-order.icon: A tall fleur-de-lis banner planted in the earth, its cloth snapping in the wind. A tall flag. White and gold. Reads at 24px as: a tall flag.
gilles-saber-saint-war-order.lore: His Saber Noble Phantasm. He can also use Jeanne's Luminosite Eternelle if he somehow obtains her flag.

gilles-saber-triumphal-return.line: Celebrates the saint's return: allies' ultimates and crits grow stronger.
gilles-saber-triumphal-return.icon: A procession arch with a banner and falling petals. An arch with flecks. Gold and white. Reads at 24px as: a gold arch.
gilles-saber-triumphal-return.lore: The page lists Triumph of the Holy Maiden as the Grand Order upgrade of Tactics, with no further detail.

gilles-substitution.line: Spends a summon or spell to slip away instead of taking a hit.
gilles-substitution.icon: A small horror taking a blade in a figure's place, the figure dissolving away. A tentacle shape before an outline. Violet and teal. Reads at 24px as: tendrils before a figure.

gogh-channel-marker-soul.line: Thrives on her curse: it hurts less and readies her ultimate.
gogh-channel-marker-soul.icon: A ship's channel-marker buoy glowing in dark water, wisps of curse around it. A buoy on a line. Sun yellow and violet. Reads at 24px as: a yellow buoy.
gogh-channel-marker-soul.lore: Born of the painter's and the fairy's souls resonating over a shared madness of total devotion, it lets Van Gogh drink in madness as Curses to gain new power and use it to guide others.

gogh-de-sterrennacht.line: The Starry Night: terrifies foes in front and opens a gate beyond.
gogh-de-sterrennacht.icon: Swirling Van Gogh night sky with a crescent moon and coiling stars. Spirals in the sky. Deep blue and sun yellow. Reads at 24px as: a yellow swirl in blue.
gogh-de-sterrennacht.lore: A Reality Marble that can swallow the world with an alternate depiction of reality, opening a gate to another world that drives onlookers mad; on fellow Foreigners it can instead deify them or sever their Outer God terminals.
gogh-de-sterrennacht.look: A Reality Marble opening a dangerous gate to another world.

gogh-het-gele-huis.line: A cold mistral howls through the yellow house, weakening foes.
gogh-het-gele-huis.icon: A small yellow house with wind streaking past its windows. A house shape in lines. Sun yellow and pale blue. Reads at 24px as: a yellow house.
gogh-het-gele-huis.lore: Listed on the wiki as her Noble Phantasm Het Gele Huis: it brings cold mistral wind and ruin on enemies while empowering allies inside the Yellow House, though it also Curses everyone within.
gogh-het-gele-huis.look: Enemies are battered by the cold wind mistral inside the house.

gogh-imaginary-numbers-arts.line: Strange magic: survives one killing blow and curses herself to grow.
gogh-imaginary-numbers-arts.icon: A painter's palette with a dark imaginary-number spiral in its paint. A palette with a swirl. Yellow and violet. Reads at 24px as: a palette.
gogh-imaginary-numbers-arts.lore: A skill blending her imaginary-number origin with Van Gogh's artistic talent, allowing her to recreate his paintings and read their symbolism into magecraft phenomena.

gogh-insanity.line: Madness sharpens her: every hit lands a bit harder.
gogh-insanity.icon: A bandaged ear beside a jagged brushstroke. A small shape and a zigzag. Bone and yellow. Reads at 24px as: a jagged stroke.
gogh-insanity.lore: A class skill of abnormal, terror-inducing thought that deviates from natural harmony and distorts the worldview of nearby minds.

gogh-shadow-of-longing.line: A painted wish: an ally near her hits harder.
gogh-shadow-of-longing.icon: Sunflowers in a water urn, a shadow falling across them. A vase with blooms. Yellow and blue. Reads at 24px as: a vase of flowers.
gogh-shadow-of-longing.lore: An upgrade of Channel Marker Soul in Grand Order, born from the painter's and fairy's resonating souls and their shared devotion-madness.

gogh-sunflowers-curse.line: Her curse can't kill her, and no order can make her end herself.
gogh-sunflowers-curse.icon: A wilting sunflower with dark tendrils curling from its centre. A flower with a dark core. Yellow and violet. Reads at 24px as: a sunflower.
gogh-sunflowers-curse.lore: Drawn from the nymph Clytie's story, it means she can never commit suicide; 'blooming' replaces it, and in serious cases she may metamorphose into the Evil God of the Flowers.
gogh-sunflowers-curse.look: In serious cases she metamorphoses into the Evil God of the Flowers.

gogh-the-yellow-house.line: Her yellow house engulfs a wide area in a freezing mistral.
gogh-the-yellow-house.icon: The yellow house seen large, its doors thrown open to a gale. A house with a blast. Sun yellow and pale blue. Reads at 24px as: a yellow house with lines.
gogh-the-yellow-house.lore: Her Noble Phantasm: it brings disaster to enemies as the cold mistral wind while blessing and protecting allies in the Yellow House, but it also Curses everyone inside.
gogh-the-yellow-house.look: Cold mistral wind rages against enemies inside the house.

golden-rule.line: Born lucky with wealth: critical hits may ready the ultimate sooner.
golden-rule.icon: A gold ingot glowing beneath a crown. A bar under a crown. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold bar.
golden-rule.lore: The measure of how much wealth follows a hero through life, for Siegfried the Nibelung treasure, which costs him Luck.
golden-rule.look: The treasure manifests as the Noble Phantasm Das Rheingold.

gray-anti-spirit-combat.line: A ghost hunter: deals much more damage to spirits and the undead.
gray-anti-spirit-combat.icon: A scythe blade passing through a wisp of ghostly smoke. A curved blade through a wisp. Steel and pale violet. Reads at 24px as: a curved blade.
gray-anti-spirit-combat.lore: Gray was raised as a gravekeeper at Blackmore, so she can fend off evil spirits; even Servants cannot easily touch her with this skill.

gray-blessings.line: A blessing from the world's end: resists curses and charges her spear.
gray-blessings.icon: A small hooded figure lit by a distant tower of light. A tower beam beyond a figure. White-gold and grey. Reads at 24px as: a figure and a light column.
gray-blessings.lore: Listed on the wiki as Protection of the Ends of the World: protection tied to the holy spear, with its rank lowered because the spear is only on loan to her.

gray-face-of-the-king.line: Hides her face under the hood and fades from enemy eyes.
gray-face-of-the-king.icon: A grey hood pulled low, a faint gold crown shape glinting in the shadow beneath. A hood with a glint. Grey and gold. Reads at 24px as: a hood.

gray-kings-reflection.line: The king's echo in her: her ultimate charges faster with each blow.
gray-kings-reflection.icon: A girl's reflection in still water showing a crowned king instead. A shape mirrored on a line. Gold and grey. Reads at 24px as: a mirrored crown.
gray-kings-reflection.lore: A skill representing Gray's capacity as the Once and Future King, granting what would be impossible for an ordinary modern human.

gray-rhongomyniad-mythos.line: Brands one enemy with the spear's mythos for a later strike.
gray-rhongomyniad-mythos.icon: Base: a lance-tip of white light. Accent: a glowing tower sigil branded on a silhouette. Reads at 24px as: a mark on a figure.
gray-rhongomyniad-mythos.lore: The function Rhongomyniad was truly made for: anchoring the world in place. Whoever it strikes, divine or dragonkind, has the bulk of their abilities sealed away.

gray-rhongomyniad.line: The lance that shines to the world's end: a beam down a line.
gray-rhongomyniad.icon: A lance of white light fired in a straight beam from a spinning drill-tip. A long horizontal beam. White-gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a white beam.
gray-rhongomyniad.lore: The spear Gray carries is only a shadow of Rhongomyniad, the anchor binding the two sides of the world; it is kept sealed in Add and released when needed.
gray-rhongomyniad.look: When activated it can launch a beam of light, and her eyes turn gold when she uses it.

gray-sealing-mystic-code-release.line: Unseals her shapeshifting tool: faster, stronger, briefly untouchable.
gray-sealing-mystic-code-release.icon: A small cube unfolding into a scythe, a mocking face on its side. A cube and a crescent. Steel grey and gold. Reads at 24px as: a cube and a crescent.
gray-sealing-mystic-code-release.lore: Listed as Mystic Code Seal Release: the code seals the Holy Spear, and Add can undergo a special release into other forms; Gray's Assassin appearance results from it.
gray-sealing-mystic-code-release.look: Add can become a scythe, boomerang, mallet, bow or spear.

habetrot-chibira-sanu.line: A giant shisa blasts heat beams; more foes nearby means more power.
habetrot-chibira-sanu.icon: A towering shisa lion-dog firing a beam from its mouth over the sea. A large beast head and a line. Sun gold and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a beast head firing.
habetrot-chibira-sanu.lore: After fusing with Shisa's Spirit Origin and gathering the island's Mabui, Habetrot becomes the legendary sacred guardian beast, a giant whose heat beams hit a single target.
habetrot-chibira-sanu.look: A giant 60 m tall and 80 tons, firing heat beams; her Shisa Kigurumi Parka form is homemade.

habetrot-divine-beasts-rage.line: As a beast, every support move builds toward a raging outburst.
habetrot-divine-beasts-rage.icon: A shisa's mane flaring like fire. A wild mane shape. Ember and gold. Reads at 24px as: a flaring mane.
habetrot-divine-beasts-rage.lore: Shisarot is the guardian beast Habetrot becomes after fusing with the Spirit Origin of the Okinawan Shisa, appearing from prayers for peace (mode of Sacred Guardian Beast). In FGO, Sacred Guardian Beast draws enemy attention and grants Guts.

habetrot-glam-sight.line: Fairy eyes: those who attack her crit a little less.
habetrot-glam-sight.icon: A fairy's eye glittering with sparkles. An eye with stars. Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: a sparkly eye.
habetrot-glam-sight.lore: In her Shisarot form her Fairy Eyes drop to E-: the cheerful eyes became ones burning with justice, making her more willing to believe villains' lies.

habetrot-great-decisive-battle.line: A southern-sea showdown: regains footing and hits harder.
habetrot-great-decisive-battle.icon: A surfboard planted in the sand like a banner, waves behind. A board and waves. Sun gold and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: an upright board.
habetrot-great-decisive-battle.lore: When Shisarot's rage and courage peak, the legendary great kaiju emerges, granting numerous attack buffs for a single turn that scale with stars.

habetrot-great-tropical-fireball.line: As a beast, hurls a tropical fireball over an area.
habetrot-great-tropical-fireball.icon: A blazing fireball trailing palm-leaf sparks. A fireball. Ember and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a fireball.
habetrot-great-tropical-fireball.lore: An attack of Habetrot in Shisarot form (mode of The Lion's Gallant Figure that Stirs the Seas), the Sacred Guardian Beast fused with Shisa's Spirit Origin and the island's Mabui. In FGO, the NP deals single-target damage, extra against Super Large foes.

habetrot-guardian-faerie.line: Guards her Master and nearest ally, softening blows on them.
habetrot-guardian-faerie.icon: A tiny faerie with a spindle shielding a figure. A small winged shape before a figure. Luck violet and blue. Reads at 24px as: wings before a figure.
habetrot-guardian-faerie.lore: Her oath after becoming Shisarot to protect a home against quakes, typhoons or fire; she cannot protect large places but defends a single house fully, and shields the Servant behind her.

habetrot-ocean-stirring.line: As a beast, a lion's roar that readies her ultimate.
habetrot-ocean-stirring.icon: A shisa roaring, waves rising around it. A roaring head in waves. Gold and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a roaring head.
habetrot-ocean-stirring.lore: An attack of Habetrot in Shisarot form (mode of The Lion's Gallant Figure that Stirs the Seas), the Sacred Guardian Beast fused with Shisa's Spirit Origin and the island's Mabui. In FGO, the NP deals single-target damage, extra against Super Large foes.

habetrot-sacred-guardian-beast.line: Draws enemy fire, and taking hits readies her ultimate.
habetrot-sacred-guardian-beast.icon: A pair of shisa statues guarding a gate. Two beasts flanking a gap. Stone and gold. Reads at 24px as: two guardian shapes.
habetrot-sacred-guardian-beast.lore: Shisarot arises from prayers for peace, and Habetrot, fused with Shisa, guards not only brides' style but the peace of everyone in the city.

habetrot-shiisaa-beam.line: As a beast, a beam down a line that breaks armour.
habetrot-shiisaa-beam.icon: A shisa's open mouth firing a straight beam. A head and a line. Gold and white. Reads at 24px as: a head with a beam.
habetrot-shiisaa-beam.lore: An attack of Habetrot in Shisarot form (mode of The Lion's Gallant Figure that Stirs the Seas), the Sacred Guardian Beast fused with Shisa's Spirit Origin and the island's Mabui. In FGO, the NP deals single-target damage, extra against Super Large foes.

habetrot-strange-giant-shadow.line: In her normal form, blends close and ranged fighting.
habetrot-strange-giant-shadow.icon: A huge shadow of a beast falling over a tiny island. A big shadow over a dot. Grey and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a large shadow.

habetrot-swimsuit.line: Beach-ready: water attacks hurt her only half as much.
habetrot-swimsuit.icon: A beach ball with a single wave splash curling over it. A circle under a curl. Sun gold and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a ball under a wave.

habetrot-yanamun-reversal.line: Turns the tables: allies near her hit demons harder.
habetrot-yanamun-reversal.icon: A glaring mask turning a demon's grin upside down. A mask over an inverted face. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a glaring mask.
habetrot-yanamun-reversal.lore: Shisarot's daunting figure and sharp glare drive off demons and send them to a world of pain, invalidating Curses, Poisons and Burn for the party and gaining stars.
habetrot-yanamun-reversal.look: A daunting figure with a sharp glare.

hassan-battle-retreat.line: Cancels an attack, flees far, and heals, but drops its buffs.
hassan-battle-retreat.icon: A dark figure leaping away into shadow, a cloak flaring. A leaping silhouette. Teal motion on night. Reads at 24px as: a leaping figure.
hassan-battle-retreat.lore: In FGO, it is Hassan of the Hundred Faces' B-rank skill that recovers his own HP at the risk of removing his own buffs; the wiki gives no lore text.

hassan-expert-of-many-specializations.line: A hundred talents: nudges dice outside combat, or picks a skill.
hassan-expert-of-many-specializations.icon: A ring of small skull masks, each a different face. A ring of ovals. Bone white on night. Reads at 24px as: a ring of masks.
hassan-expert-of-many-specializations.lore: Listed as All Kinds of Specializations: he switches between his personalities to apply professional skills, showing 32 specialties (tactics, espionage, assassination, rhetoric) at Rank B or above.

hassan-librarian-of-stored-knowledge.line: Vast learning: crits more and readies its ultimate faster.
hassan-librarian-of-stored-knowledge.icon: Stacked scrolls with one unrolled, its script glowing. A stack with a glow. Bone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a stack of scrolls.
hassan-librarian-of-stored-knowledge.lore: Listed as Librarian of Knowledge: memory is processed across his multiple personalities, so a passed Luck check recalls past knowledge even if it was never noticed.

hassan-zabaniya-delusional-illusion.line: A hundred bodies: only falls when all hundred are defeated.
hassan-zabaniya-delusional-illusion.icon: Dozens of black silhouettes behind one white skull mask. Many shapes behind an oval. Bone white mask, shadow crowd. Reads at 24px as: a mask in a crowd.
hassan-zabaniya-delusional-illusion.lore: He splits his psyche into 100 personalities (80 can manifest at once), each a separate body with its own skills; the sum is weaker than the whole, but Presence Concealment is shared.
hassan-zabaniya-delusional-illusion.look: Multiple separate bodies manifest, each a different persona.

heracles-bravery.line: Fearless: resists mind tricks and can boost physical damage.
heracles-bravery.icon: A lion's face roaring in gold. A rounded mane shape. Ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold mane.
heracles-bravery.lore: His daring spirit shuts out mental interference like suppression, confusion and charm, and raises melee damage; it stops working under Mad Enhancement.

heracles-eye-of-the-mind-false.line: Battle instinct: dodges, and lands harder critical blows.
heracles-eye-of-the-mind-false.icon: A narrowed eye with a feint line slicing past it. An eye and a slash. Agility teal. Reads at 24px as: a slit eye.
heracles-eye-of-the-mind-false.lore: A danger-avoidance sense born of many ordeals, almost an instinct, that still works despite his madness and sees through feints.

heracles-god-hand.line: Twelve labours: comes back to life again and again.
heracles-god-hand.icon: A massive bronze torso with twelve small lights in a ring over the heart. A broad shape with a ring of dots. Bronze and gold. Reads at 24px as: a ring of twelve dots.
heracles-god-hand.lore: An immortality blessing and curse: his body becomes armour that nullifies attacks of Rank B or lower, and it revives him 11 times, so he must die 12 times.
heracles-god-hand.look: It has no outward manifestation like a weapon or armour; the body itself is the Noble Phantasm.

heracles-indomitable.line: Refuses to fall: survives a killing blow and fights on.
heracles-indomitable.icon: A huge hand gripping a stone axe planted in the ground. A fist on a haft. Stone grey with gold backlight. Reads at 24px as: a fist on a vertical.
heracles-indomitable.lore: The FGO upgrade of Battle Continuation, which lets him keep fighting after mortal wounds and ties in with God Hand's resurrection.

heracles-nine-lives.line: Nine killing strikes at once, then the target's guard is broken.
heracles-nine-lives.icon: Nine arrows converging on one point like the heads of a hydra. Lines meeting at a point. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a fan converging.
heracles-nine-lives.lore: The Noble Phantasm he used to slay the Hydra: nine strikes so fast they overlap, which he can also reproduce with other weapons.
heracles-nine-lives.look: It takes the form of a bow and arrow.

jabberwock-alice-eater.line: The beast hits harder and lingers on the field longer.
jabberwock-alice-eater.icon: The Jabberwock's jaw closing on a playing card. A jaw and a rectangle. Black and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a jaw on a card.
jabberwock-alice-eater.lore: The skill the Jabberwock uses to temporarily strengthen itself in Fate/EXTRA.

jack-information-erasure.line: Erases what enemies learned about her when she slips away.
jack-information-erasure.icon: A notebook page with its writing dissolving into mist. A page fading. Bone parchment in grey mist. Reads at 24px as: a fading page.
jack-information-erasure.lore: The instant a battle ends, witnesses and opponents forget her abilities, True Name and appearance, even if recorded on camera.

jack-maria-the-ripper-slaughter.line: In the night mist, against a woman, a certain and brutal kill.
jack-maria-the-ripper-slaughter.icon: Base: four surgical knives in a cross. Accent: they sink into thick yellow mist under a crescent moon. Reads at 24px as: knives in fog.
jack-maria-the-ripper-slaughter.lore: Maria the Ripper reproduces her murders as a concept: with the conditions of night, a female target and mist met, power rises and the target's insides are expelled; it acts as a curse rather than a knife attack.
jack-maria-the-ripper-slaughter.look: The target ends up as a dismembered corpse; it works at range as a curse.

jack-maria-the-ripper.line: A savage knife attack, twice as deadly against women.
jack-maria-the-ripper.icon: Four surgical knives fanned in a cross, their edges gleaming. A cross of blades. Steel and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a blade cross.
jack-maria-the-ripper.lore: Maria the Ripper reproduces her murders as a concept: with the conditions of night, a female target and mist met, power rises and the target's insides are expelled; it acts as a curse rather than a knife attack.
jack-maria-the-ripper.look: The target ends up as a dismembered corpse; it works at range as a curse.

jack-murderer-of-the-misty-night.line: Strikes first when attacked from within reach.
jack-murderer-of-the-misty-night.icon: A knife flashing out of fog before a blade can fall. A blade in mist. Steel and grey. Reads at 24px as: a glint in fog.
jack-murderer-of-the-misty-night.lore: Because she is a murderer rather than an assassin, she always gets the first move on her victim at night; by day a luck roll is needed.

jack-surgical-procedure.line: Stitches up herself or an ally a little.
jack-surgical-procedure.icon: A curved needle drawing black thread that writhes like a worm. A hook with a line. Steel and black thread. Reads at 24px as: a hook and thread.
jack-surgical-procedure.lore: She heals herself or her Master with blood-stained scalpels, using crude anatomical techniques from 120 years ago aided by mana.
jack-surgical-procedure.look: Stitches are made with black thread that writhes like an earthworm.

jack-the-mist.line: Fills an area with toxic fog that hides her and hurts foes.
jack-the-mist.icon: A thick yellow-grey fog rolling over London rooftops. A ragged cloud over a skyline. Sulfur grey. Reads at 24px as: a grey cloud.
jack-the-mist.lore: A Bounded Field Noble Phantasm recreating London's sulfuric-acid smog; Servants take no damage but lose a rank of Agility, and she picks who is affected.
jack-the-mist.look: A mist of sulfuric acid, created with magical energy.

karl-cannons.line: His fortress's cannons shell an area at range.
karl-cannons.icon: A castle turret's cannon firing a gold shell. A tower and a dot. Stone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a turret firing.

karl-carolus-patricius.line: Raises a giant fortress over the field to shelter his allies.
karl-carolus-patricius.icon: A vast cathedral-fortress with a cross on its spire, rising from the ground. A tall crenellated shape. White stone, gold cross. Reads at 24px as: a fortress with a cross.
karl-carolus-patricius.lore: An automatically expanding giant fortress that is both the armour covering Karl and the domain of his mobile holy city.
karl-carolus-patricius.look: A giant fortress; its attack form is a cathedral-and-cross robot.

karl-ceremonial-reformation.line: While he stands, all allies hit harder and take less.
karl-ceremonial-reformation.icon: A crowned eagle's wings spread over a group. Wings over a row. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: spread gold wings.
karl-ceremonial-reformation.lore: A skill that improves the functioning of the peoples and lands under Karl's rule, reflecting how he built up his theocratic empire as emperor.

karl-cpa-auctoritas.line: Summons a giant cathedral robot and rides on top of it.
karl-cpa-auctoritas.icon: Base: a giant robot built of cathedral spires and a cross. Accent: standing upright, the emperor on its crown. Reads at 24px as: a tall robot.
karl-cpa-auctoritas.lore: The trump card of Carolus Patricius, turning the fortress into an attack form to sweep enemies away.
karl-cpa-auctoritas.look: A giant humanoid robot built from cathedral and cross elements, firing missiles from shoulder launchers and a beam from its mouth.

karl-cpa-sanctus.line: The cathedral robot fires twice over a wide area.
karl-cpa-sanctus.icon: Base: the cathedral robot. Accent: shoulder launchers firing, a beam from its mouth. Reads at 24px as: a robot with a beam.
karl-cpa-sanctus.lore: The trump card of Carolus Patricius, turning the fortress into an attack form to sweep enemies away.
karl-cpa-sanctus.look: A giant humanoid robot built from cathedral and cross elements, firing missiles from shoulder launchers and a beam from its mouth.

karl-great-emperor-privilege.line: An emperor's due: heals and may gain several boosts.
karl-great-emperor-privilege.icon: A sceptre with a jewelled orb, a green glow around it. A rod with a sphere. Gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a rod and orb.
karl-great-emperor-privilege.lore: A skill that lets Karl acquire Skills he lacks for a short time; same effect as Imperial Privilege under a self-declared name.

karl-holy-king.line: A holy king: hurts demons and pagan gods more and takes less.
karl-holy-king.icon: A cross-topped crown with rays. A crown and cross. White-gold. Reads at 24px as: a crowned cross.
karl-holy-king.lore: A skill giving Karl advantages against demonic enemies and non-Saint divinities.

karl-joyeuse.line: His peerless sword hits dark and demonic foes much harder.
karl-joyeuse.icon: A sword whose blade shimmers through many colours, a spearhead set in its pommel. A blade with a gem pommel. Prismatic steel. Reads at 24px as: a shimmering blade.
karl-joyeuse.lore: The holy sword of Charlemagne and Karl, famed in the Song of Roland; Karl, rooted in history rather than fantasy, cannot use it to its full potential.
karl-joyeuse.look: Its colour changes 30 times a day, and the head of the Holy Lance is kept in its pommel.

karna-brahmastra-kundala.line: A sun-fire blast over a huge area that leaves everyone burning.
karna-brahmastra-kundala.icon: Base: a projectile of pure sunfire. Accent: it explodes into a dome of flame. Reads at 24px as: a fiery dome.
karna-brahmastra-kundala.lore: The anti-country Noble Phantasm Karna got from the Brahmin Parashurama; with his fire attribute one blow is likened to a nuclear weapon.
karna-brahmastra-kundala.look: A bow if he is an Archer, a projectile in other classes.

karna-brahmastra.line: A sure-hit sun shot that crushes those weaker than him.
karna-brahmastra.icon: A projectile of pure sunfire streaking in a straight line. A flaming streak. Sun gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold streak.
karna-brahmastra.lore: An anti-army, anti-country weapon from Parashurama that pursues and surely hits when the god Brahma is named, but a curse stops him using it on stronger opponents.
karna-brahmastra.look: A bow as Archer, otherwise a different projectile weapon.

karna-discernment-of-the-poor.line: Sees through a foe: seals their ultimate and opens them to curses.
karna-discernment-of-the-poor.icon: A piercing golden eye beside a sword crossed by an X. An eye and an X. Gold and crimson. Reads at 24px as: an eye beside an X.
karna-discernment-of-the-poor.lore: Insight into an opponent's character and nature, so he is not deceived by excuses; it comes from his life asking after the weak.

karna-end-of-charity.line: Gives all he has: his mastery fully wakes and allies crit more.
karna-end-of-charity.icon: An open hand offering a glowing sun-disc. A palm under a sun. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a hand under a sun.
karna-end-of-charity.lore: Karna gave his golden armor to Indra, the almsgiver's tale behind this skill (wiki name Almsgiver's End). In FGO, it charges Karna's NP gauge, raises star generation and critical damage and gains stars.

karna-fated-rivals.line: If Arjuna is near, the two rivals fight only each other.
karna-fated-rivals.icon: Base: two blades crossed, one of white fire and one of gold sun. Accent: Arjuna's blade is the white-blue fire one, held in front. Reads at 24px as: an X of two colours.

karna-flash-of-the-sun-god.line: Blazes with the sun: regains footing and hits very hard.
karna-flash-of-the-sun-god.icon: A sun flaring behind a spearhead. A point in a starburst. Sun gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold burst.
