karna-flash-of-the-sun-god.lore: The Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Mana Burst (Flames), infusing his weapons with blazing magical energy.
karna-flash-of-the-sun-god.look: Blazing flames dwell in whatever weapon he holds.

karna-kavacha-and-kundala.line: Golden armour of the sun: takes almost no damage, but drains the Master.
karna-kavacha-and-kundala.icon: Golden armour fused to a chest, radiating sunlight from earrings. A breastplate with rays. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a radiant breastplate.
karna-kavacha-and-kundala.lore: Golden armour and earring given by the sun god Surya to protect Karna, formed of light so even gods struggle to destroy it, and fused with his body.
karna-kavacha-and-kundala.look: Golden armour radiating the light of the sun, fused with him.

karna-mana-burst-flames.line: Flame in every strike: may burn foes, and fire barely hurts him.
karna-mana-burst-flames.icon: Base: an impact burst of fire erupting from a strike. Accent: the fire is the white-blue of Arjuna's flame. Reads at 24px as: a flame burst.
karna-mana-burst-flames.lore: The power to put magical energy into weapons; for Karna, blazing flames dwell in every weapon he grasps, and it is usually active.
karna-mana-burst-flames.look: Blazing flames dwell in the weapon.

karna-uncrowned-arms-mastership.line: Untitled mastery: crits either more often or harder.
karna-uncrowned-arms-mastership.icon: A spear without a crown, a thin laurel snapped beside it. A spear and a broken ring. Gold and grey. Reads at 24px as: a spear and a broken ring.
karna-uncrowned-arms-mastership.lore: Listed as Uncrowned Martial Arts: his arms skills went unrecognised, so opponents see his weapon ranks and Riding and Divinity one degree lower until his True Name is revealed.

karna-vasavi-shakti-activation.line: Gives up his armour forever for Indra's lightning spear.
karna-vasavi-shakti-activation.icon: A spear of lightning and light rising as golden armour falls away. A bright spear over falling plates. White-gold lightning. Reads at 24px as: a lightning spear.
karna-vasavi-shakti-activation.lore: The spear of light is made by converting his golden armour, trading tremendous defence for a strong anti-god weapon.
karna-vasavi-shakti-activation.look: A spear made of lightning and light.

karna-vasavi-shakti.line: Hurls Indra's lightning spear into an area, leaving it in flames.
karna-vasavi-shakti.icon: Base: the spear of lightning and light. Accent: it strikes down, splitting the ground into a burning crater. Reads at 24px as: a bolt into a crater.
karna-vasavi-shakti.lore: A one-shot spear of light that takes down even gods, manifested by converting his golden armour.
karna-vasavi-shakti.look: A spear of light made from lightning.

kingprotea-airavata-king-size.line: Grows to full size and crushes foes; bigger means stronger.
kingprotea-airavata-king-size.icon: A colossal silhouette rising from a glowing ocean, its head above the clouds. A huge figure over a horizon. Verdant ocean, white-gold sky. Reads at 24px as: a giant over a line.
kingprotea-airavata-king-size.lore: A Noble Phantasm she shows as a Chaldea Servant at the cost of ranking down her Saint Graph, relieving the pressure of the Counter Force and physics.
kingprotea-airavata-king-size.look: A Reality Marble that deploys the cybernetic world SE.RA.PH and returns her to her original size.

kingprotea-divine-core.line: A goddess's core: every hit is stronger, and curses miss more.
kingprotea-divine-core.icon: A glowing seed-like core inside a lotus petal. A bright dot in a petal. White-gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a dot in a petal.
kingprotea-divine-core.lore: The Divine Core of the Goddess marks her as a perfected goddess from birth, preserving mind and body: mental interference is mostly mitigated and her body cannot shrink to human size.

kingprotea-earth-mothers-wail.line: A wail of the earth mother: a magical blow at extra reach.
kingprotea-earth-mothers-wail.icon: Concentric sound rings spreading from a vast open mouth over the ground. Arcs widening. Verdant and Mana blue. Reads at 24px as: widening arcs.

kingprotea-giant-monster-of-the-great-ri.line: Her growth stocks feed her ultimate when she flexes her strength.
kingprotea-giant-monster-of-the-great-ri.icon: A huge shadow in a river's flood, gold scales glinting. A dark shape in waves. Verdant water, gold glints. Reads at 24px as: a shape in waves.
kingprotea-giant-monster-of-the-great-ri.lore: A skill expressing Kingprotea's enormous power as a mythic giant. In FGO, it raises her attack and NP damage per Growth stack.

kingprotea-huge-scale.line: So huge she walks through anything, shoving units aside.
kingprotea-huge-scale.icon: A giant foot stepping over tiny figures. A large foot above dots. Bone and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a big foot.
kingprotea-huge-scale.lore: A skill born of Growth Desire from Self-Modification that lets her size grow without limit, raising its own cap each time it is exceeded.

kingprotea-infantile-regression.line: Sheds her growth to ready her ultimate sooner.
kingprotea-infantile-regression.icon: A giant silhouette shrinking into a small child's, a stream of light flowing out. Large to small shapes. White-gold. Reads at 24px as: a big and a small figure.
kingprotea-infantile-regression.lore: A safety shackle put on by BB that restores her to a younger state and resets her hypertrophied self once her age passes a set value.

kingprotea-monstrous-strength.line: Brute force: one strike's physical damage more than doubles.
kingprotea-monstrous-strength.icon: A monstrous fist shattering stone. A fist over cracks. Iron and ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a fist in a burst.
kingprotea-monstrous-strength.lore: A demonic-entity skill that temporarily amplifies STR; she has it at EX, shared only by Tiamat.

kingprotea-self-suggestion.line: Convinces herself she's fine: clears debuffs and resists more.
kingprotea-self-suggestion.icon: A hand on its own forehead, a small sun glowing beneath it. A hand over a dot. Verdant and gold. Reads at 24px as: a hand over a light.
kingprotea-self-suggestion.lore: Suggestion applied to oneself, raising resistance to mental interference; at EX the mental world is beyond understanding.

kingprotea-territory-creation.line: Strong at home: hits harder in her base, and allies there take less.
kingprotea-territory-creation.icon: A magic circle glowing on a stone floor, with low walls of light rising at its rim. A flattened ellipse with a rising rim. Crimson-violet circle on deep violet night. Reads at 24px as: a glowing ring on the ground.
kingprotea-territory-creation.lore: An abnormal Territory Creation skill: Protea keeps hypertrophying her own Saint Graph and is herself a temple, synonymous with a territory.

kiritsugu-affection-of-the-holy-grail.line: The Grail's favour: his luck is perfect and nearby units roll better.
kiritsugu-affection-of-the-holy-grail.icon: A golden chalice tilted, a single drop of light falling on a die. A cup over a cube. Gold and Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: a cup over a cube.
kiritsugu-affection-of-the-holy-grail.lore: Kiritsugu is deeply loved by the Greater Holy Grail, a love equal to the world's greatest curse, flipping his Luck beyond the standard and letting him break through otherwise unbreakable Servants.

kiritsugu-chronos-rose.line: Accelerates time for a vicious shot that ignores defences and stalls the foe.
kiritsugu-chronos-rose.icon: A rose whose petals are clock hands, a bullet trail through it. A flower with hands. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a clock-faced rose.
kiritsugu-chronos-rose.lore: A Noble Phantasm built on his Innate Time Control (Time Alter), accelerating his own time for extreme consecutive attacks or slowing it to hide.

kiritsugu-familiars.line: Scout familiars extend his reach and sharpen long-range crits.
kiritsugu-familiars.icon: A bat-winged familiar with a camera lens for an eye. A winged shape with a ring. Ink and Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: a winged eye.
kiritsugu-familiars.lore: A thaumaturgy of Kiritsugu Emiya, the Mage Killer (mode of Magecraft B). In FGO, his Magecraft B raises his Arts performance for 1 turn; the wiki lists no spell by this name.

kiritsugu-lethal-gunfire-suppression.line: Lays down suppressing fire: regains luck and hits much harder.
kiritsugu-lethal-gunfire-suppression.icon: A submachine gun's muzzle flash in a tight burst. A short barrel and a flash. Steel and ember. Reads at 24px as: a gun flash.
kiritsugu-lethal-gunfire-suppression.lore: Listed as Lethal Suppression by Gunfire: the Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Magecraft.

kiritsugu-magecraft.line: Casts one spell a turn, each one prolonging his suppression.
kiritsugu-magecraft.icon: A magic circle forming in an open palm. A ring above a hand. Mana blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue ring.
kiritsugu-magecraft.lore: He learned magecraft, and because he understands it he excels at killing mages, with bonuses to checks against Casters.

kiritsugu-mystery-bisection.line: A close cut that may kill and permanently cripples the target.
kiritsugu-mystery-bisection.icon: A plain combat knife cutting a magic circle in two. A blade through a ring. Steel and Mana blue. Reads at 24px as: a split ring.
kiritsugu-mystery-bisection.lore: Phantasm Punishment: a knife carrying his Origin of Severing and Binding, which deals fatal damage to foes with Magic Circuits or Crests.

kiritsugu-penetration.line: His attacks pierce armour and shields for a short while.
kiritsugu-penetration.icon: A bullet passing clean through a shield, leaving a neat hole. A dot through a shield. Steel and blue. Reads at 24px as: a holed shield.
kiritsugu-penetration.lore: A thaumaturgy of Kiritsugu Emiya, the Mage Killer (mode of Magecraft B). In FGO, his Magecraft B raises his Arts performance for 1 turn; the wiki lists no spell by this name.

kiritsugu-reinforcement.line: Strengthens his weapon by magic for one fight.
kiritsugu-reinforcement.icon: A blade with blue circuit lines running along it. A blade with a glow. Mana blue on steel. Reads at 24px as: a blade with blue lines.
kiritsugu-reinforcement.lore: A thaumaturgy of Kiritsugu Emiya, the Mage Killer (mode of Magecraft B). In FGO, his Magecraft B raises his Arts performance for 1 turn; the wiki lists no spell by this name.

kiritsugu-scapegoat.line: Marks an ally as bait to draw enemy fire.
kiritsugu-scapegoat.icon: A paper target pinned on a figure's back. A target on an outline. Bone ink and crimson rings. Reads at 24px as: a target on a figure.
kiritsugu-scapegoat.lore: A set of crafty techniques for surviving the battlefield.

kiritsugu-suppression-shot.line: Shoots back at anyone who attacks his bait.
kiritsugu-suppression-shot.icon: A crosshair snapping onto an attacker beside a bullseye. A crosshair and a target. White and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a crosshair.
kiritsugu-suppression-shot.lore: Kiritsugu's mage-killing firearm tactics. In FGO, Lethal Suppression by Gunfire raises his Arts performance and removes an enemy buff when attacking, boosting his attack on success.

lanceturia-blessings.line: A blessing from the world's end: clears debuffs and readies her ultimate.
lanceturia-blessings.icon: A distant tower of light on the horizon, rays reaching back. A thin vertical light on a line. White-gold. Reads at 24px as: a light column.
lanceturia-blessings.lore: As bearer of the Holy Lance that anchors the planet, Artoria receives divine protection from the Farthest Ends itself.

lanceturia-invisible-air.line: Wind hides her lance: she moves faster and dodges better.
lanceturia-invisible-air.icon: Base: a weapon wrapped in swirling wind, only the grip seen. Accent: Lancer's is a lance's grip, longer. Reads at 24px as: a grip in a swirl.
lanceturia-invisible-air.lore: A Noble Phantasm which, with Mana Burst, boosts Agility and gives a super-jump, and lets her release stockpiled wind at once.
lanceturia-invisible-air.look: Stored wind, released as a long-range area blast.

lanceturia-mana-burst.line: Pours magic into a strike: a much heavier blow that ignores resistance.
lanceturia-mana-burst.icon: Base: an impact burst of mana erupting from a strike. Accent: Lancer's burst is white with a storm-grey rim. Reads at 24px as: a white burst.
lanceturia-mana-burst.lore: Temporarily strengthens her by infusing body and weapon with magical energy, at poor mana efficiency.

lanceturia-rhongomyniad.line: The lance at the world's end: a pillar of light over an area.
lanceturia-rhongomyniad.icon: A towering lance spinning into a pillar of light that pierces the sky. A tall spiral column. White-gold. Reads at 24px as: a spiral pillar.
lanceturia-rhongomyniad.lore: The Holy Lance, a Divine Construct and Spear of the End whose true form is the tower fastening the World's surface to the planet; the Thirteen Restraints limit it to a Noble Phantasm.
lanceturia-rhongomyniad.look: Its light is a pillar of light; the spiral light of the lance pierced a dragon.

lanceturia-strike-air.line: Releases stored wind in a burst that splits its force among foes.
lanceturia-strike-air.icon: Base: the wind-wrapped grip. Accent: wind bursting outward in a fan. Reads at 24px as: a grip firing a fan.
lanceturia-strike-air.lore: Using all the stockpiled wind at once to fire a long-range area attack that mows down enemies.

lanceturia-torrent-of-light.line: A surge of light: huge damage, more against the chaotic.
lanceturia-torrent-of-light.icon: A river of white light pouring down a lance. A downward flood on a line. White-gold. Reads at 24px as: a bright stream.
lanceturia-torrent-of-light.lore: The Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Mana Burst.

lanceturia-wild-hunt.line: Leads the hunt: allies near her hit harder for a turn.
lanceturia-wild-hunt.icon: Spectral hounds and riders sweeping across a storm sky. Running shapes in clouds. Storm grey and gold. Reads at 24px as: running shapes.
lanceturia-wild-hunt.lore: In FGO, it is Lancer Artoria's B+ skill, upgrade of Charisma, raising party attack and NP damage, with extra NP damage for Round Table Knight allies.

mannanan-fragarach-counter.line: Fires back automatically with an unstoppable piercing beam.
mannanan-fragarach-counter.icon: A floating metal sphere firing a needle of blue light. A ball and a thin line. Steel and blue. Reads at 24px as: a dot with a line.
mannanan-fragarach-counter.lore: Fragarach is the ultimate counterattack: it rewinds time so it strikes first, wiping out the enemy's trump card before it happened.
mannanan-fragarach-counter.look: A floating metal sphere that glows, becomes charged and fires a needle-thin beam of blue light into the heart.

mannanan-fragarach-enbarr.line: The sea-foam steed: she draws fire and gains power from her tokens.
mannanan-fragarach-enbarr.icon: A white horse of sea foam galloping over waves. A horse shape in spray. White and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a white horse.
mannanan-fragarach-enbarr.lore: Manannan's version of Fragarach, merged with Aonbharr the white foam steed, so he can easily make many Fragarachs.
mannanan-fragarach-enbarr.look: Takes the form of Aonbharr, the white steed of sea foam.

mannanan-fragarach.line: Answers an enemy ultimate by striking first, undoing it.
mannanan-fragarach.icon: A metal sphere crackling with charge, about to fire a needle beam backwards in time. A ball with a reversed arrow. Steel and blue. Reads at 24px as: a ball with a curl.
mannanan-fragarach.lore: The sword and concept of retrograde counterattack: it severs fates and strikes first against an enemy's strongest attack.
mannanan-fragarach.look: A floating metal sphere that glows, becomes charged and fires a needle-thin beam of blue light into the heart.

mannanan-gods-holder-possession.line: When falling, the god inside takes over and she fights on.
mannanan-gods-holder-possession.icon: A woman's silhouette with a sea god's crowned shadow rising behind it. Two overlapping figures. Sea blue and gold. Reads at 24px as: a figure with a crown behind.

mannanan-hallowed-sea-gods-sword.line: A sacred sword strike that is hard to dodge.
mannanan-hallowed-sea-gods-sword.icon: A sword dripping sea water, edge glinting. A blade with drops. Sea blue and steel. Reads at 24px as: a wet blade.

mannanan-sea-gods-rune.line: A sea god's rune: readies her ultimate and sharpens her crits.
mannanan-sea-gods-rune.icon: A rune carved into a wave-washed stone. A glyph on a rock. Mana blue on grey. Reads at 24px as: a rune on stone.
mannanan-sea-gods-rune.lore: Bazett's rune magecraft, drawing on the power of Manannan. In FGO, it charges her NP gauge and raises star absorption and critical damage.

mannanan-sealing-designation-enforcer.line: A hardened enforcer: regains footing and hits much harder.
mannanan-sealing-designation-enforcer.icon: A leather glove clenched, a small rune stone in the fist. A fist with a glint. Black leather and blue. Reads at 24px as: a black fist.
mannanan-sealing-designation-enforcer.lore: A fighting style embedded deep in Bazett's body, meant for use against mages. In FGO, it raises Quick, Buster, critical damage and damage against Casters.

mannanan-successor-of-the-red-branch.line: Heir of the Red Branch: dodges, shrugs off curses, rallies crits.
mannanan-successor-of-the-red-branch.icon: A red branch of a tree with a single leaf. A forked line. Crimson branch on night. Reads at 24px as: a red branch.
mannanan-successor-of-the-red-branch.lore: In FGO (as Succession of the Red Branch B), it grants Bazett Evasion and Debuff Immunity for 1 turn and gains stars; the wiki gives no lore text.

mannanan-toole-fragarach.line: Three gouging greatsword strikes in quick succession.
mannanan-toole-fragarach.icon: A greatsword leaving three parallel slashes. Three diagonal lines. Steel and blue. Reads at 24px as: three slashes.
mannanan-toole-fragarach.lore: An ability from Fate/unlimited codes using three successive strikes of Fragarach without its counter ability.

mannanan-tradition-carrier.line: Gathers sword tokens over time to fuel her abilities.
mannanan-tradition-carrier.icon: Five small metal spheres orbiting a hand. Dots around a shape. Steel and blue. Reads at 24px as: dots in a ring.
mannanan-tradition-carrier.lore: A sorcery trait in the Fraga bloodline's blood: faithful service to ancient gods earned knowledge of runes and the right to use Fragarach, passed to one successor per generation.

medea-aero.line: A slicing wind spell that leaves the target bleeding.
medea-aero.icon: A crescent of cutting wind. A thin curved blade of air. Pale teal on night. Reads at 24px as: a curved line.
medea-aero.lore: A plague-wind spell that minces part of a target's chest as if through an enormous fan.

medea-argos.line: Conjures a glass-like barrier that halves damage taken.
medea-argos.icon: A pane of hexagonal glass panels forming before a hand. A honeycomb wall. Guard blue glass. Reads at 24px as: a hexagon pane.
medea-argos.lore: A protective spell borrowing the concept of Argos, a glass-like barrier as tough as Heracles's skin.

medea-atlas.line: A binding spell that stuns one foe.
medea-atlas.icon: A ring of light clamping around a silhouette. A figure in a ring. Yellow shock on violet. Reads at 24px as: a figure in a ring.
medea-atlas.lore: A support spell that freezes the target in place by changing atmospheric pressure, strong enough to hold even Servants.

medea-dragon-tooth-warriors.line: Scatters dragon teeth that rise as skeleton soldiers.
medea-dragon-tooth-warriors.icon: A dragon's tooth planted in the ground with a skeletal arm rising from it. A fang and a hand. Bone white on night. Reads at 24px as: a fang with a hand.
medea-dragon-tooth-warriors.lore: Magic using dragon teeth as foci to create golem soldiers that attack enemy Masters and Servants.
medea-dragon-tooth-warriors.look: Golem soldiers of varying appearance, wielding different weapons.

medea-golden-fleece.line: Wraps in the golden fleece to heal and recover.
medea-golden-fleece.icon: A golden ram's fleece draped like a cloak. A soft curled shape. Gold with verdant glow. Reads at 24px as: a gold fleece.
medea-golden-fleece.lore: The pelt of the golden winged ram of Colchis; legend says a dragon rises if it is thrown on the earth, but Medea cannot summon it.

medea-high-speed-divine-words.line: Recites at impossible speed: every spell recharges at once.
medea-high-speed-divine-words.icon: Lips speaking a stream of glowing glyphs that wrap into a spiral. A spiral of marks. Mana blue. Reads at 24px as: a glyph spiral.
medea-high-speed-divine-words.lore: An Age of Gods language that activates magecraft without Magic Circuits, letting spells fire with a single action.

medea-item-construction.line: Allies nearby land curses more easily and shrug them off better.
medea-item-construction.icon: A round alchemist's flask with a glowing liquid and a small gear stamped on the glass. A round-bottomed flask. Verdant liquid in smoked glass on violet night. Reads at 24px as: a round green flask.
medea-item-construction.lore: Lets her manufacture magical items, such as Mystic Codes surpassing modern ones and healing potions granting limited immortality.

medea-keraino.line: A swift-wind spell that lets her move much farther.
medea-keraino.icon: A winged sandal over a gust. A sandal with wings. Agility teal. Reads at 24px as: a winged shape.
medea-keraino.lore: A spell used alongside her electrical attacks and other wind magecraft.

medea-rain-of-light.line: Rains beams of light down on an area.
medea-rain-of-light.icon: Dozens of thin beams raining from a magic circle above. A ring with falling lines. Violet and white light. Reads at 24px as: a ring raining lines.
medea-rain-of-light.lore: Her main offensive spell: rapid beams of light, each of A rank power, able to wreck a Servant's body.
medea-rain-of-light.look: Rapidly fired beams of light like a bombing raid, scorching the ground red.

medea-rule-breaker.line: A dagger that dispels buffs and can cut a Servant from its Master.
medea-rule-breaker.icon: A jagged rainbow-hued ritual dagger with a broken chain. A zigzag blade. Prismatic violet. Reads at 24px as: a zigzag blade.
medea-rule-breaker.lore: An anti-magecraft dagger that dispels any magecraft and can sever the Servant-Master contract, letting Medea take the Command Seals.
medea-rule-breaker.look: A ceremonial dagger with a blunt blade.

medea-teachings-of-circe.line: Circe's lessons: heals an ally, clears curses, readies their ultimate.
medea-teachings-of-circe.icon: A pig-shaped amulet glowing with green light in an open hand. A small shape in a palm. Verdant. Reads at 24px as: a glow in a hand.
medea-teachings-of-circe.lore: The lessons Circe imparted to her while they studied in a temple of Hecate.

medea-trofa.line: A spell that makes her slip any attack.
medea-trofa.icon: A cloak fluttering where a figure was, scattered feathers. An empty cloak. Violet and teal. Reads at 24px as: an empty cloak.
medea-trofa.lore: A spatial transportation spell imitating the True Magic of teleportation, moving herself or others.

medusa-bellerophon.line: Charges on Pegasus in a blazing straight line across the field.
medusa-bellerophon.icon: A winged white horse diving in a comet of light, a golden bridle on it. A winged shape in a streak. White and gold. Reads at 24px as: a white winged streak.
medusa-bellerophon.lore: Medusa's strongest attack, an anti-army Noble Phantasm of a paired bridle and whip that rapidly boosts a Phantasmal Species steed, so mount and rider fight as one.
medusa-bellerophon.look: A bridle and whip pair used with Pegasus, who fights as one with Medusa.

medusa-blood-fort-andromeda.line: Marks four corners to raise a temple that drains everyone inside.
medusa-blood-fort-andromeda.icon: A blood-red magic circle with four marked corners, a dome of red light rising. A square of dots under a dome. Crimson on night. Reads at 24px as: a red dome.
medusa-blood-fort-andromeda.lore: A bounded field that is the counterpart to Breaker Gorgon; once activated it dissolves people inside, used less for combat than for gathering blood and prana.
medusa-blood-fort-andromeda.look: Magic circles placed at predetermined points to form the field.

medusa-blood-temple.line: Readies her ultimate sooner, and faster while her temple stands.
medusa-blood-temple.icon: A single drop of blood falling into a rune circle. A drop over a ring. Crimson. Reads at 24px as: a red drop on a ring.

medusa-monstrous-snake-metamorphosis.line: Turns more monster: stronger blows and fiercer criticals.
medusa-monstrous-snake-metamorphosis.icon: Strands of hair turning into hissing snakes. Curling lines with heads. Violet and steel. Reads at 24px as: writhing curls.
medusa-monstrous-snake-metamorphosis.lore: In FGO, Medusa (Lancer)'s skill raises her attack and critical damage and her damage against enemies with an Immobility debuff for 3 turns; the wiki gives no lore text.

medusa-monstrous-strength.line: Brute force: one strike's physical damage nearly doubles.
medusa-monstrous-strength.icon: A monstrous fist shattering stone. A fist over cracks. Iron and ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a fist in a burst.
medusa-monstrous-strength.lore: Medusa's monster nature lets her temporarily raise her Strength by one rank.

medusa-mystic-eyes.line: Her gaze turns a nearby foe to stone.
medusa-mystic-eyes.icon: An eye with a square pupil, rings of stone spreading from it. A square-pupilled eye. Pale violet and stone grey. Reads at 24px as: an eye with a square.
medusa-mystic-eyes.lore: Cybele, the highest-order Mystic Eyes of Petrification, which petrify targets of low mana rank and pressure higher ones; Breaker Gorgon usually seals them.
medusa-mystic-eyes.look: The corneas take in no light, the pupils see the world through a square, and the fixed irises cannot close.

mental-pollution.line: A twisted mind: curses land more easily and mind tricks don't work.
mental-pollution.icon: A head silhouette filled with black ink swirling outward. A head with a dark spiral. Violet-black on night. Reads at 24px as: a head with a swirl.
mental-pollution.lore: A skill from a distorted mind that shuts out mental interference magecraft. Its holder cannot understand anyone lacking equal Mental Pollution.

nemo-barrel-bombing.line: Drops explosive barrels on an area, setting foes ablaze.
nemo-barrel-bombing.icon: A banded barrel with a lit fuse, mid-fall. A barrel shape with a spark. Wood and ember. Reads at 24px as: a barrel with a spark.

nemo-great-ram-nautilus.line: Rams the submarine Nautilus straight through the enemy line.
nemo-great-ram-nautilus.icon: A submarine's great iron ram bursting through a wall of water. A pointed prow in spray. Steel and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a prow in spray.
nemo-great-ram-nautilus.lore: The submarine Nautilus charges forward with its giant ram, a concept-backed strike that pierces any enemy however large; it is stronger and more accurate near water.
nemo-great-ram-nautilus.look: Takes the shape of the submarine Nautilus driving a large ram.

nemo-indomitable.line: Refuses to sink: survives a killing blow and readies his ultimate.
nemo-indomitable.icon: A huge hand gripping a stone axe planted in the ground. A fist on a haft. Stone grey with gold backlight. Reads at 24px as: a fist on a vertical.
nemo-indomitable.lore: Nemo's spirit and beliefs given form as a skill that acts as both Battle Continuation and NP gain, with extra gain when the Guts effect triggers.

nemo-journeys-guidance.line: Guides the crew: allies near him or aboard get stronger.
nemo-journeys-guidance.icon: A ship's compass needle glowing, pointing ahead. A needle in a circle. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a compass.
nemo-journeys-guidance.lore: Rooted in Triton guiding the Argo, it guards the hopes of those heading for unseen lands; its effect doubles on waterfront fields.

nemo-poseidons-protection.line: The sea god's favour: sharper magic crits, and stronger near water.
nemo-poseidons-protection.icon: A trident rising out of a wave. A three-pronged shape over a curve. Sea blue and gold. Reads at 24px as: a trident.
nemo-poseidons-protection.lore: Protection of the Sea God: as son of Poseidon and Amphitrite, water follows his will and his defence rises near water.

nemo-quickfire.line: Rapid gunfire: a hail of shots that may each hit.
nemo-quickfire.icon: Six small muzzle flashes in a row. A row of sparks. Ember on night. Reads at 24px as: a row of sparks.

nemo-tritons-conch.line: Blows a conch: sound waves batter everything around him.
nemo-tritons-conch.icon: A spiral conch with sound rings blasting from its mouth. A spiral shell and arcs. Pearl and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a shell with arcs.
nemo-tritons-conch.lore: Nemo carries a conch shell horn from which he can unleash deadly sound waves; the page gives no skill entry beyond this mention.
nemo-tritons-conch.look: A conch shell horn that emits sound waves.

nemo-voyager-of-the-storm.line: Captain of the Storm Border; can rally those aboard.
nemo-voyager-of-the-storm.icon: A tricorne hat in a lashing gale, rain streaking. A hat shape in diagonal lines. Gold trim, storm blue. Reads at 24px as: a hat in streaks.
nemo-voyager-of-the-storm.lore: A captain skill that fits Nemo only loosely, drawing on his experience sailing through storms at Zero-sail; it doubles in effect on waterfront fields.

nemo-zero-sail.line: Dives his ship into imaginary space, carrying allies with him.
nemo-zero-sail.icon: A ship diving into a swirl of inverted starry space. A prow entering a vortex. Sea blue and violet stars. Reads at 24px as: a prow in a swirl.
nemo-zero-sail.lore: The Nautilus and Shadow Border were combined with Hephaestus Klironomia and Triton's power into the Storm Border, which dives through Imaginary Number Space; his Zero-sail storm voyages are noted in his skills.
nemo-zero-sail.look: A ship that dives through Imaginary Number Space.

normal-magic-crest.line: The Master fires their family's inherited magic for a heavy, Noble-Phantasm-class blast.
normal-magic-crest.icon: A magic crest: a circuit of glowing lines running up a forearm and opening into a circle at the wrist. A diagonal arm ending in a ring. Mana blue lines on night, a gold spark at the circle's centre. Reads at 24px as: a blue ring at the end of a stroke.
normal-magic-crest.lore: A Magic Crest is a series of Magic Circuits given a stable form to act as an archive of a magus's spells, passed down a lineage as its most important treasure.
normal-magic-crest.look: Engraved on the body in various shapes, most typically a magic circle.

nursery-a-tale-for-somebodys-sake.line: A storybook spell over an area that weakens and stalls foes.
nursery-a-tale-for-somebodys-sake.icon: An open picture book with pages blowing out like a storm. A book and flying leaves. Bone and Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: an open book with flecks.
nursery-a-tale-for-somebodys-sake.lore: Her Anti-Unit Noble Phantasm in FGO, whose verse speaks of an endless story that goes on while the reader keeps rejecting reality.

nursery-frenzied-march-hare.line: A mad hare's wind spell that may sap the target.
nursery-frenzied-march-hare.icon: A hare with a pocket watch leaping through a gust. A leaping animal. Teal and gold. Reads at 24px as: a leaping hare.
nursery-frenzied-march-hare.lore: A wind attack spell of Nursery Rhyme.

nursery-jabberwock.line: Summons the Jabberwock beast for a few turns.
nursery-jabberwock.icon: The Jabberwock's winged, long-necked silhouette rising from a book's pages. A winged beast over a book. Black and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a winged beast.
nursery-jabberwock.lore: Her Fate/EXTRA Noble Phantasm: in the story she fights Hakuno's Servant as the Jabberwock, first mistaken for a Berserker; its verse speaks of fire breathing dragons and giants.

nursery-meanwhile.line: Turn the page: heals, clears debuffs and readies her ultimate.
nursery-meanwhile.icon: A page turning with a soft green glow. A curling leaf of paper. Verdant. Reads at 24px as: a turning page.
nursery-meanwhile.lore: A skill about boarding a ship with reliable friends toward either a hopeful encounter or a trap, inviting all to the reverse side of the world.

nursery-nameless-forest.line: A forest that makes nearby foes forget their own names.
nursery-nameless-forest.icon: Bare trees with blank name tags on their branches. Tree shapes with small squares. Grey and Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: bare trees.
nursery-nameless-forest.lore: A Reality Marble unleashed on Hakuno and their Servant in Fate/EXTRA that makes the target's existence fade, ending with the line that their name is hers.

nursery-plains-of-winter.line: A wintry spell that may freeze the target in place.
nursery-plains-of-winter.icon: A snowflake falling on a frozen flat plain. A star over a line. Ice white. Reads at 24px as: a snowflake.
nursery-plains-of-winter.lore: An ice attack spell of Nursery Rhyme.

nursery-queens-glass-game.line: A tea party that, if foes linger near her too long, ends badly for them.
nursery-queens-glass-game.icon: A glass chessboard with a teapot as the queen. A grid with a figure. Glass and gold. Reads at 24px as: a checkered square.
nursery-queens-glass-game.lore: Her main Noble Phantasm in Fate/EXTRA, built on the relic Perpetual Engine - Maiden Empire, with a verse about a story that never ends while the reader refuses reality.

nursery-self-modification.line: Rewritten herself: crits land harder and can come more often.
nursery-self-modification.icon: A doll's stitched seam glowing with a star. A seam with a spark. Bone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a stitch with a star.
nursery-self-modification.lore: The aptitude to graft entirely different flesh onto one's own body; the higher the rank, the further one is from a pure hero.

nursery-shapeshift.line: A body made of story: takes less damage.
nursery-shapeshift.icon: A figure dissolving into pages and reforming. A silhouette of flying sheets. Bone and blue. Reads at 24px as: a figure of pages.
nursery-shapeshift.lore: A skill of transformation, voiced as 'I am you, you are me', at A+ rank.

nursery-tommy-thumb.line: A secret picture book: regains luck, hits harder and toughens up.
nursery-tommy-thumb.icon: A tiny boy standing on an open book, a thimble as a helmet. A small figure on a book. Bone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a tiny figure on a book.
nursery-tommy-thumb.lore: In Fate/Grand Order this is the upgraded form of her Shapeshift skill.

nursery-trump-soldiers.line: Summons a squad of playing-card soldiers around her.
nursery-trump-soldiers.icon: A fan of playing cards standing up as soldiers with spears. A fan of rectangles. White and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a fan of cards.
nursery-trump-soldiers.lore: Listed as one of Nursery Rhyme's Noble Phantasms, but the page gives no description of it.

nursery-white-queens-enigma.line: A riddle that makes Alice's attacks curse the target too.
nursery-white-queens-enigma.icon: A white chess queen with a question mark for a crown. A figure with a curl. White and Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: a white queen.
nursery-white-queens-enigma.lore: An enchantment that lowers the enemy's magic resistance when she lands certain strikes.

olga-defender-normal-attack.line: A sweeping attack over an area that weakens with each unit caught.
olga-defender-normal-attack.icon: Base: the Defender of Humanity star. Accent: radiating a square blast. Reads at 24px as: a star with a square.
olga-defender-normal-attack.lore: Defender of Humanity (mode of): in FGO, it makes Olga Marie's Extra Attack hit all enemies and grants Guts against Threat to Humanity enemies.

olga-defender-of-humanity.line: If a threat to humanity kills her, she rises again at half strength.
olga-defender-of-humanity.icon: A crest of the Human Order, a white star over a globe. A star over a circle. White and gold. Reads at 24px as: a star over a globe.
olga-defender-of-humanity.lore: Listed as her class skill Defender of the Human Order (C rank); the wiki gives no description beyond the name.

olga-earth-shattering.line: Instantly readies her ultimate and supercharges it.
olga-earth-shattering.icon: A planet cracking open, light pouring from the fissure. A cracked circle. Gold and black. Reads at 24px as: a cracked orb.
olga-earth-shattering.lore: In FGO, Olga Marie's B-rank skill charges her NP gauge by 300% and overcharges her NP, at the cost of unkillable damage to the party.

olga-flawlessness.line: When her ultimate is ready, resets it and gains more damage.
olga-flawlessness.icon: A perfect polished sphere reflecting stars. A smooth orb. Silver and gold. Reads at 24px as: a shiny orb.
olga-flawlessness.lore: In FGO, Olga Marie's EX skill spends 300% NP to boost her and the party's Buster, critical damage and NP gain and ignore Invincibility.

olga-four-elements.line: Splits into four elemental selves for a random elemental strike.
olga-four-elements.icon: Four small figures, fire, water, earth, wind, in a ring. Four dots in a cross. Four element colours. Reads at 24px as: four coloured dots.
olga-four-elements.lore: Her second Noble Phantasm, an occasional happening in which she splits into the four elemental Olga Maries, each tied to one of her core emotions.
olga-four-elements.look: She splits into four elemental Olga Maries.

olga-gravity-manipulation.line: Floats and drags nearby foes down with crushing gravity.
olga-gravity-manipulation.icon: A black hole bending lines around it. A dark circle with warped rings. Black and violet. Reads at 24px as: a dark ring.
olga-gravity-manipulation.lore: She manipulates space-time, levitating by warping gravity and casually creating pseudo-black holes or a 'Haste Makes Waste' gravity field.
olga-gravity-manipulation.look: She levitates and makes black holes; in reality she weighs over ten kilotons.

olga-gyakkou.line: Backlight: each time she returns from death, she comes back stronger.
olga-gyakkou.icon: A silhouette lit from behind by a blinding light. A dark figure in a halo. White-gold. Reads at 24px as: a backlit figure.
olga-gyakkou.lore: Backlight: in FGO a passive that, when Guts activates, grants Olga Marie Buster up, Invincibility and an NP charge at the cost of Max HP.

olga-planet-olga-marie.line: Becomes a planet that crushes a huge area and slows everyone.
olga-planet-olga-marie.icon: A planet with rings bearing down on a tiny horizon. A large ringed orb over a line. Violet and gold. Reads at 24px as: a ringed planet.
olga-planet-olga-marie.lore: A Human Order Correction Spell that proves human extinction is possible and disproves it as fantasy, reenacting the Alien God's Authority and all disasters on a miniature Earth.

olga-unparalleled.line: Without equal: all her skills recharge and her ultimate strengthens.
olga-unparalleled.icon: A crown floating alone above an empty throne. A crown over a chair. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a crown.
olga-unparalleled.lore: In FGO, Olga Marie's EX skill cuts her cooldowns by 2, raises NP damage, gains stars, seals enemy NP and reduces enemy healing.

ozymandias-dendera-electric-bulb-area.line: The temple's solar bulb bombards a small area from afar.
ozymandias-dendera-electric-bulb-area.icon: Base: the glowing Dendera bulb with a lotus base. Accent: it fires a spread of four bolts. Reads at 24px as: a bulb firing a fan.
ozymandias-dendera-electric-bulb-area.lore: The temple's main offence, an anti-fortress magical energy bombardment with heat at solar-flare level, strong enough to turn a city to ash at full power.
ozymandias-dendera-electric-bulb-area.look: A bombardment of magical energy with the heat of a solar flare.

ozymandias-dendera-electric-bulb.line: Inside his temple, a solar bulb blasts one target from afar.
ozymandias-dendera-electric-bulb.icon: A giant glowing lotus-shaped bulb firing a single bolt of sunlight. A bulb shape and a line. Sun gold and white. Reads at 24px as: a bulb firing a line.
ozymandias-dendera-electric-bulb.lore: The temple's main offence, an anti-fortress magical energy bombardment with heat at solar-flare level, strong enough to turn a city to ash at full power.
ozymandias-dendera-electric-bulb.look: A bombardment of magical energy with the heat of a solar flare.

ozymandias-imperial-privilege.line: A pharaoh's due: heals and may gain several boosts.
ozymandias-imperial-privilege.icon: A crook and flail crossed over a sun disc. Crossed rods. Gold and lapis. Reads at 24px as: crossed rods.
ozymandias-imperial-privilege.lore: Lets him acquire skills he lacks for a short time; at A rank it even grants bodily burdens such as Divinity.

ozymandias-mesektet.line: His solar barque fires every ordinary attack, burning the dark.
ozymandias-mesektet.icon: A vast golden sun-boat sailing through the night sky, firing beams. A crescent boat with rays. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold crescent with rays.
ozymandias-mesektet.lore: The solar boat of the sun god Ra, which flies the skies and fires beams of light that scorch the earth; he can summon only parts of it.
ozymandias-mesektet.look: A huge flying ship firing several beams of light; even its prow alone is large enough to wreck a workshop.

ozymandias-pharaoh-of-the-hot-sands.line: The pharaoh's rule: allies near him hit harder, more by day.
ozymandias-pharaoh-of-the-hot-sands.icon: A nemes headdress over rolling dunes. A striped headdress shape. Gold and lapis. Reads at 24px as: a striped headdress.
ozymandias-pharaoh-of-the-hot-sands.lore: God-King of the Hot Sands, the FGO upgrade of his Charisma skill.

ozymandias-protection-from-ra.line: Ra's favour: allies' ultimates come sooner and buffs land surer.
ozymandias-protection-from-ra.icon: A winged sun disc. A circle with spread wings. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a winged disc.
ozymandias-protection-from-ra.lore: Protection of the Sun God: Ozymandias receives the divine protection of the sun god Ra, at A+ rank.

ozymandias-pyramid-drop.line: Drops a pyramid on an area, sealing ultimates and breaking armour.
ozymandias-pyramid-drop.icon: A gold-capped pyramid falling point-down onto the ground. An inverted triangle. Sandstone and gold. Reads at 24px as: an upside-down triangle.
ozymandias-pyramid-drop.lore: A last-resort anti-unit attack made by releasing the True Name of Ramesseum Tentyris, hurling the pyramid so its mass crushes the enemy.
ozymandias-pyramid-drop.look: A pyramid thrown down on the target.

ozymandias-ramesseum-tentyris.line: Raises his shining temple complex over a huge area.
ozymandias-ramesseum-tentyris.icon: A colonnade of giant pillars and statues under a blazing sun. A row of columns. Sandstone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a row of pillars.
ozymandias-ramesseum-tentyris.lore: A Reality Marble-like Noble Phantasm that manifests a great temple complex around him.

ozymandias-sphinx-of-abu-el-hol.line: Three sphinxes rise to guard his temple.
ozymandias-sphinx-of-abu-el-hol.icon: A lion-bodied sphinx crouching with a pharaoh's head. A crouching lion shape. Sandstone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a crouching sphinx.
ozymandias-sphinx-of-abu-el-hol.lore: Lets him summon Sphinxes, Divine Beasts that embody the sky god Horus and out-damage modern weaponry.

pale-rider-contagion.line: Disease spreads to foes around it every turn.
pale-rider-contagion.icon: Sickly green spores drifting from a cloak. Dots spreading from a shape. Verdant-sick and grey. Reads at 24px as: a cloud of dots.
pale-rider-contagion.lore: Expands territory by splitting into viruses and bacteria that infect other lifeforms, bringing body and mind under control and dragging the mind into its Noble Phantasm's world.

pale-rider-doomsday-come.line: Opens a realm of the dead around its Master.
pale-rider-doomsday-come.icon: A ring of ground cracking open into a pale void. A ring around a dark centre. Bone white and black. Reads at 24px as: a dark ring.
pale-rider-doomsday-come.lore: Creates a bounded world, an artificial underworld rooted on the Master, which receives the deaths Pale Rider bestows and can shape into heaven, hell or oblivion.
pale-rider-doomsday-come.look: An artificial underworld ward that can take the shape of heaven, hell or void depending on the Master.

pale-rider-doomsday-drag.line: Drags a nearby foe into the realm of the dead.
pale-rider-doomsday-drag.icon: Pale hands reaching out of a dark ring to pull a figure down. Hands around a figure. Bone and black. Reads at 24px as: hands on a figure.

pale-rider-guidance-of-the-netherworld.line: Guides allies near it: stronger, with death's favour.
pale-rider-guidance-of-the-netherworld.icon: A pale lantern held over a dark road. A light on a stick. Bone and pale green. Reads at 24px as: a lantern.
pale-rider-guidance-of-the-netherworld.lore: Grants a variety of divine blessings to those it regards as allies inside its underworld territory.

pale-rider-innocent-world.line: In its realm, foes are hindered by their own greatest strength.
pale-rider-innocent-world.icon: A scale with a figure's own sword weighing it down. A balance with a blade. Bone and grey. Reads at 24px as: a tipped scale.
pale-rider-innocent-world.lore: A skill that reflects humanity's fear of death and disease; the images are simplified when recalled and vary for each person in the underworld.

pale-rider-kagome-kagome.line: Summons a spirit of sword, famine, death or beast against each foe.
pale-rider-kagome-kagome.icon: Four spectral figures in a ring, holding hands around a blindfolded shape. A ring of four. Pale and black. Reads at 24px as: a ring of four figures.
pale-rider-kagome-kagome.lore: Manifests and wields the power of many objects that impart death within its ward, and could recreate a mythic doomsday if magical energy allowed.

penthesilea-charisma.line: A queen's presence: allies near her hit harder, unless she's raging.
penthesilea-charisma.icon: A gold crown with a single raised banner behind it. A crown under a vertical flag. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold crown.
penthesilea-charisma.lore: B rank Charisma, enough to lead a nation as queen and keep her forces' morale extremely high.

penthesilea-goddess-of-war.line: Ares' sash: stronger blows and tougher hide while she keeps her head.
penthesilea-goddess-of-war.icon: A war-god's sash belted at the waist, gold buckle blazing. A belt with a buckle. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold buckle.
penthesilea-goddess-of-war.lore: A sash in which the power of the war god Ares, ancestor of the Amazons, resides; she wears it round her waist.
penthesilea-goddess-of-war.look: A sash worn around her waist.

penthesilea-golden-rule-beauty.line: Her beauty shields her from curses and readies her ultimate.
penthesilea-golden-rule-beauty.icon: A gold mirror reflecting a cracked face. A round mirror. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold mirror.
penthesilea-golden-rule-beauty.lore: The fate of growing into a goddess-like flawless beauty however she is raised, so that at Troy she was mistaken for a true goddess.

penthesilea-hatred-of-achilles.line: Any Greek man nearby sends her into a berserk rage.
penthesilea-hatred-of-achilles.icon: A bronze Greek helm cracked by a fist. A crested helm with a crack. Bronze and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a cracked helm.
penthesilea-hatred-of-achilles.lore: Penthesilea's vengeful hatred for Achilles; in FGO her reason blows away when she faces him and, to a degree, other hated Greek heroes (Mad Enhancement EX bond text, and her NP Outrage Amazon).

penthesilea-howl-of-the-war-god.line: A war howl: allies near her hit harder physically.
penthesilea-howl-of-the-war-god.icon: A roaring mouth with sound rings and Amazon spears behind. Arcs and spears. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: arcs and spears.
penthesilea-howl-of-the-war-god.lore: Roar of the War God: a shout that awakens Ares' blood and lends bravery to allies beside her; it will not stop when facing Greek heroes until they are dead.
penthesilea-howl-of-the-war-god.look: Shown in the wiki as an image of her roaring while the Amazons are empowered.

penthesilea-outrage-amazon.line: In mad fury, a crushing blow that breaks the target's guard.
penthesilea-outrage-amazon.icon: Spiked iron gauntlets swinging down in a blur. A fist arc. Iron and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a heavy fist arc.
penthesilea-outrage-amazon.lore: She excites her vengeance against Achilles and Ares' blood, turning herself into a true mad warrior that has thrown away reason.

proto-gil-bab-ilu.line: The king's key: closes in after a ranged hit for a second strike.
proto-gil-bab-ilu.icon: A golden key with a king's sigil. A key shape. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold key.
proto-gil-bab-ilu.lore: The tattoo that marks him as king and acts as the key to his treasury, the Prototype version of the Gate of Babylon.
proto-gil-bab-ilu.look: A tattoo that identifies him as king.

proto-gil-charisma.line: A king's presence: allies near him hit harder.
proto-gil-charisma.icon: A gold crown with a single raised banner behind it. A crown under a vertical flag. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold crown.

proto-gil-enki.line: The sword of the end: a growing flood that drowns everything at last.
proto-gil-enki.icon: A sword raised as a towering wave builds behind it. A blade before a wave. Sea blue and gold. Reads at 24px as: a blade before a wave.
proto-gil-enki.lore: A sword that summons floods whose water grows each day until, after seven days, it becomes a giant tsunami called the Flood of Utnapishtim.
proto-gil-enki.look: A sword that calls up a growing flood and a tsunami.

proto-gil-enkidu.line: Heaven's chains bind one foe, stronger against the divine.
proto-gil-enkidu.icon: Golden chains bursting from a ripple and coiling. Coiled links. Gold. Reads at 24px as: coiled chains.
proto-gil-enkidu.lore: Enkidu was made by the gods to bind Gilgamesh and bring him back to heaven, but became his friend; the Chain of Heaven is his divine binding chain.

proto-gil-golden-rule.line: Born lucky with wealth: critical hits may ready the ultimate sooner.
proto-gil-golden-rule.icon: A gold ingot glowing beneath a crown. A bar under a crown. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold bar.

proto-gil-levitation.line: Floats: moves a bit farther and over obstacles.
proto-gil-levitation.icon: A figure hovering above a shadow, gold sparks below. A figure above a line. Gold and teal. Reads at 24px as: a floating figure.

proto-gil-treasury-of-babylon.line: Reaches into his treasury: readies his ultimate and crits far more.
proto-gil-treasury-of-babylon.icon: A golden ripple in the air with jewelled hilts emerging from it. A ring with points. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold ripple.
proto-gil-treasury-of-babylon.lore: Bab-Ilu: the tattoo that marks him as king and is the key to opening his treasury (the Gate of Babylon).
proto-gil-treasury-of-babylon.look: A tattoo marks him as king (Prototype Gilgamesh).

quetz-charisma-of-the-sun.line: Sun-bright cheer: allies near her hit harder and keep fighting.
quetz-charisma-of-the-sun.icon: A blazing Aztec sun face with a broad smile. A rayed disc with a face. Sun gold and turquoise. Reads at 24px as: a smiling sun.
quetz-charisma-of-the-sun.lore: The FGO upgrade of her Charisma skill; the page gives no further description.

quetz-ehecatle.line: From the sky serpent's back, a wind blast that saps an area.
quetz-ehecatle.icon: A spiral of wind in the Aztec stepped-scroll style. A stepped spiral. Turquoise. Reads at 24px as: a turquoise spiral.

quetz-goddesses-divine-core.line: A goddess's core: every hit is much stronger, and curses miss often.
quetz-goddesses-divine-core.icon: A glowing seed-like core inside a lotus petal. A bright dot in a petal. White-gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a dot in a petal.
quetz-goddesses-divine-core.lore: Expresses being a perfected goddess from birth: it repels mental interference and keeps body and form from changing, as a composite including Divinity, at EX rank.

quetz-good-gods-wisdom.line: A kind god's wisdom: an ally gets a second life and more.
quetz-good-gods-wisdom.icon: A feathered hand resting on a kneeling figure's head. A hand over a kneeling shape. Turquoise feathers, gold light. Reads at 24px as: a hand over a figure.
quetz-good-gods-wisdom.lore: Once an Authority, now a skill because she is a Divided Spirit; she can use many skills at A rank and grant them to other Servants.

quetz-lucha-libre.line: Wrestling flair: huge crit chance and crit damage for a moment.
quetz-lucha-libre.icon: A luchador mask with a feathered serpent motif. A mask shape. Turquoise, crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a bright mask.
quetz-lucha-libre.lore: She fights barehanded in lucha libre style, also wielding her myth's macuahuitl weapon, with aerial techniques emphasised and locking holds sealed.
quetz-lucha-libre.look: A macuahuitl, a weapon with an ordinary look yet painful to punch against.

quetz-piedra-del-sol.line: Raises the Sun Stone over the field, empowering her while it hangs.
quetz-piedra-del-sol.icon: The Aztec Sun Stone, a carved disc of rings and glyphs, hovering in sunlight. A ringed disc. Sandstone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a ringed disc.
quetz-piedra-del-sol.lore: Her trump card, the Aztec Sun Stone megalith held in a temple dedicated to her in Mesopotamia; destroying that temple would diminish her divinity.
quetz-piedra-del-sol.look: A megalith, the Aztec Sun Stone.

quetz-tlaelquiyahuitl.line: From the sky serpent's back, a downpour that slows an area.
quetz-tlaelquiyahuitl.icon: Stepped Aztec rain glyphs falling in columns. Vertical stepped lines. Sea blue. Reads at 24px as: blue falling lines.

quetz-tlahuitequiliztli.line: From the sky serpent's back, lightning that shocks an area.
quetz-tlahuitequiliztli.icon: A jagged Aztec lightning glyph. A zigzag. Yellow shock and turquoise. Reads at 24px as: a yellow zigzag.

quetz-winged-serpent.line: Summons a giant winged reptile and flies on it with her Master.
quetz-winged-serpent.icon: A colossal feathered pterosaur in flight, wings spread wide. A wide wing span. Turquoise and gold. Reads at 24px as: spread wings.
quetz-winged-serpent.lore: Summons a Quetzalcoatlus, a giant Cretaceous pterosaur raised to Phantasmal or Divine Beast level; at True Name release the rider can command large-scale lightning, wind and rain.
quetz-winged-serpent.look: A giant pterosaur, the largest flying animal in history.

quetz-xiuhcoatl.line: A flaming meteor dive that seals the target's ultimate and burns them.
quetz-xiuhcoatl.icon: A fiery serpent-shaped meteor diving from the sky. A flaming streak with a head. Ember and turquoise. Reads at 24px as: a fiery streak.
quetz-xiuhcoatl.lore: Her second Noble Phantasm, which briefly stops enemies from invoking their Noble Phantasms' True Names before she strikes them down with a meteor-like Lucha Libre blow.

raikou-dohatsu-tenshou.line: In fury, calls her four retainers' lightning weapons down on an area.
raikou-dohatsu-tenshou.icon: Four lightning-forged weapons crashing down together. Four bolts converging. Yellow-violet lightning. Reads at 24px as: four converging bolts.
raikou-dohatsu-tenshou.lore: Goo Shorai - Tenmokaikai (mode of): Raikou summons the divine ox messenger of Gozu Tenno, the source of her demonic nature, and sweeps the enemy camp. In FGO it hits all enemies, and at B++ boosts star generation on overcharge.
raikou-dohatsu-tenshou.look: Weapons manifest by lightning, modeled on the souls of her four retainers.

raikou-genji-clan-martial-arts-disciplin.line: Genji training: weakening barely works on her, and she crits more.
raikou-genji-clan-martial-arts-disciplin.icon: A katana in a Genji gentian crest. A blade in a crest. Steel and violet. Reads at 24px as: a blade in a crest.
raikou-genji-clan-martial-arts-disciplin.lore: Her Genji arms mastery at EX rank, the Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Eternal Arms Mastery; the page gives no further description.

raikou-mana-burst-lightning.line: Lightning in her strikes: immune to shock, and lightning barely hurts her.
raikou-mana-burst-lightning.icon: Base: an impact burst erupting from a strike. Accent: it crackles with violet lightning. Reads at 24px as: a violet burst.
raikou-mana-burst-lightning.lore: Because Gozu Tennou is the incarnation of Taishakuten (Indra), Raikou holds Kitano Tenjin's thunder power, expressed as a Mana Burst skill.

raikou-mystery-slayer.line: Slayer of the uncanny: hits monsters and demons much harder.
raikou-mystery-slayer.icon: A demon's horned mask split by a sword stroke. A mask cut by a line. Crimson and steel. Reads at 24px as: a split mask.
raikou-mystery-slayer.lore: Her fame as the Heian era's strongest slayer of mysteries became a skill that is especially effective as Anti-Mystery.

raikou-tenmokaikai.line: The net of heaven: no foe on the field escapes her storm.
raikou-tenmokaikai.icon: A net of lightning stretched across a storm sky. A web of zigzags. Violet lightning on night. Reads at 24px as: a lightning web.
raikou-tenmokaikai.lore: Her Noble Phantasm, Ox-King Storm Call - The Inescapable Net of Heaven, which overpowered Suzuka Gozen's Noble Phantasm in Fate/EXTRA CCC Fox Tail.

raikou-thunder-gods-embodiment.line: Becomes the thunder god: hits much harder and dodges.
raikou-thunder-gods-embodiment.icon: A drum ring of thunder around a woman's silhouette. A ring of drums. Violet and gold. Reads at 24px as: a ring around a figure.
raikou-thunder-gods-embodiment.lore: Thunder God Manifestation, the FGO upgrade of her Mana Burst (Lightning) skill.

rama-brahmastra.line: A burning arrow-sword that devastates demons above all.
rama-brahmastra.icon: A sword shaped like an arrow, blazing as it is thrown. A blade with flame. Ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a flaming blade.
rama-brahmastra.lore: Originally an arrow, but Rama, who wanted to be a Saber, forcibly remodelled it into a sword that can still be thrown violently.
rama-brahmastra.look: A sword that was originally an arrow.

rama-curse-of-separation.line: If he falls for good, Sita may appear in his place.
rama-curse-of-separation.icon: Two hands reaching for each other, a crack between them. Two hands and a gap. Gold and crimson. Reads at 24px as: two hands apart.
rama-curse-of-separation.lore: A curse laid by Vali's wife, so Rama can never meet Sita, his other half; when summoned, Sita appears as a separate aspect of Rama.

rama-dream-of-reunion.line: Each time he returns from death, his hope of reunion grows.
rama-dream-of-reunion.icon: A crescent moon over two silhouettes walking toward each other. Two figures under a moon. Gold and blue. Reads at 24px as: two figures under a moon.
rama-dream-of-reunion.lore: The FGO upgrade of Curse of Separation; the page gives no further description.

rama-martial-blessing.line: Vishnu's martial blessing: unlocks his weapons and sharpens crits.
rama-martial-blessing.icon: Four divine arms behind a figure, each holding a weapon. A figure with fanned arms. Gold and blue. Reads at 24px as: a figure with many arms.
rama-martial-blessing.lore: Rama, fated to defeat Ravana, excels in all martial arts; it lets him wield his spear and bow at near-Noble Phantasm power as a Saber.

rama-modhaki-and-shikhari-normal-attack.line: Once a round, a club swing that hits a little harder.
rama-modhaki-and-shikhari-normal-attack.icon: Base: twin clubs. Accent: a single swing arc. Reads at 24px as: a club and an arc.
rama-modhaki-and-shikhari-normal-attack.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: the clubs (gada) Modhaki and Shikhari.

rama-modhaki-and-shikhari.line: Twin clubs smash one foe, pinning them and shaking all around.
rama-modhaki-and-shikhari.icon: Two heavy clubs crossed, the ground cracking under them. Crossed clubs over cracks. Bronze and earth. Reads at 24px as: crossed clubs.
rama-modhaki-and-shikhari.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: the clubs (gada) Modhaki and Shikhari.

rama-pinaka-normal-attack.line: Once a round, a long bow shot that might break the bow.
rama-pinaka-normal-attack.icon: Base: Shiva's great bow. Accent: a single arrow loosed. Reads at 24px as: a bow and arrow.
rama-pinaka-normal-attack.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: Shiva's bow Pinaka.

rama-pinaka.line: Shiva's bow: a heavy long shot that may burn.
rama-pinaka.icon: A huge bow strung with fire, a crescent moon at its tip. A large arc. Ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a large bow.
rama-pinaka.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: Shiva's bow Pinaka.

rama-shuuravara-normal-attack.line: Once a round, a javelin throw at range, slightly weaker.
rama-shuuravara-normal-attack.icon: Base: a javelin. Accent: in flight. Reads at 24px as: a thin diagonal.
rama-shuuravara-normal-attack.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: the javelin Shuuravara.

rama-shuuravara.line: A javelin that may slow its target and opens their guard.
rama-shuuravara.icon: A long javelin piercing the air, a wake behind it. A long diagonal line. Steel and gold. Reads at 24px as: a long spear line.
rama-shuuravara.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: the javelin Shuuravara.

rama-sudarshana-normal-attack.line: Once a round, a chakram throw at range, weaker.
rama-sudarshana-normal-attack.icon: Base: the spinning chakram. Accent: in flight. Reads at 24px as: a ring in motion.
rama-sudarshana-normal-attack.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: the chakram discs, thrown weapons.

rama-sudarshana.line: A spinning chakram that hits two foes and may cut them.
rama-sudarshana.icon: A spinning disc-blade with flames along its edge. A spiked ring. Gold and ember. Reads at 24px as: a spiked ring.
rama-sudarshana.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: the chakram discs, thrown weapons.

rama-trishula-normal-attack.line: Once a round, a trident thrust at reach.
rama-trishula-normal-attack.icon: Base: the trident. Accent: a thrust. Reads at 24px as: a trident point.
rama-trishula-normal-attack.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: Shiva's trident Trishula.

rama-trishula.line: A lightning trident sweep that may shock everyone in front.
rama-trishula.icon: A trident crackling with lightning. A three-pronged shape. Gold and yellow shock. Reads at 24px as: a lit trident.
rama-trishula.lore: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: Shiva's trident Trishula.

rama-vishnu-bhuja.line: Vishnu's arms: a random set of divine weapons each battle.
rama-vishnu-bhuja.icon: A wheel of divine weapons arranged like a clock: chakram, club, trident, bow, javelin. A ring of weapons. Gold and blue. Reads at 24px as: a weapon wheel.
rama-vishnu-bhuja.lore: Rama's second Noble Phantasm, giving him the many weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons; higher Divinity raises how many he can bring out.
rama-vishnu-bhuja.look: A set of weapons including chakrams, a javelin, clubs, a trident and a bow.

scathach-ar.line: A sun rune: an ally regains footing and hits much harder.
scathach-ar.icon: A primordial rune shaped like a rising sun, glowing ember. A semicircle glyph. Ember on grey. Reads at 24px as: a sun rune.
scathach-ar.lore: A rune of Scathach's Primordial Runes (mode of Primeval Rune). In FGO, Primeval Rune raises one ally's Quick performance and buff success rate and charges their NP gauge.

scathach-gae-bolg-alternative.line: Twin spears: stuns, then likely kills; if not, a brutal hit.
scathach-gae-bolg-alternative.icon: Two crimson spears, one thrust and one thrown, crossing. A red X. Crimson. Reads at 24px as: a red X.
scathach-gae-bolg-alternative.lore: Scathach holds two spears older than Cu Chulainn's Gae Bolg: one pins a foe in place at close range, and a thrown second one pierces everything in its line.
scathach-gae-bolg-alternative.look: Demonic spears, one used close and one thrown.

scathach-gate-of-skye.line: Opens the gate to the land of shadows: the unlucky are swallowed.
scathach-gate-of-skye.icon: A towering dark gate opening onto a void of shadow. An arch with darkness. Black and violet. Reads at 24px as: a dark arch.
scathach-gate-of-skye.lore: Her main Noble Phantasm summons a massive gate to the Land of Shadows that draws in life; targets who fail resistance die, and she can choose who may enter.
scathach-gate-of-skye.look: A massive gate to the Land of Shadows.

scathach-god-slayer.line: A slayer of gods: much more damage to the divine and the undead.
scathach-god-slayer.icon: A spear through a broken halo. A line through a broken ring. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a spear through a ring.
scathach-god-slayer.lore: Her long slaying of divine spirits as gatekeeper of the Shadow Realm became a skill strongly effective against Divine Spirits, wraiths and Servants with Divinity.

scathach-primordial-rune-spells.line: A rune master: some rune spells cost no cooldown.
scathach-primordial-rune-spells.icon: A circle of primordial runes carved into stone, one lit. A ring of glyphs. Mana blue on grey. Reads at 24px as: a ring of glyphs.
scathach-primordial-rune-spells.lore: She knows the Primal Runes of the Age of Gods spread by Odin, different from modern runes; she gave Cu Chulainn 18 of them.
scathach-primordial-rune-spells.look: Rune effects shown as fire tornadoes, ice spikes, a rune map and a rune barrier.

scathach-primordial-rune.line: Casts random primordial runes on an ally or foe.
scathach-primordial-rune.icon: Two eight-sided rune dice tumbling, glowing glyphs on their faces. Two dice. Mana blue. Reads at 24px as: two dice.
scathach-primordial-rune.lore: She knows the Primal Runes of the Age of Gods spread by Odin, different from modern runes; she gave Cu Chulainn 18 of them.
scathach-primordial-rune.look: Rune effects shown as fire tornadoes, ice spikes, a rune map and a rune barrier.

scathach-thurs.line: A thorn rune that shocks the target with lightning.
scathach-thurs.icon: The thorn rune crackling with lightning. A pointed glyph. Yellow shock on grey. Reads at 24px as: a sharp glyph.
scathach-thurs.lore: A rune of Scathach's Primordial Runes (mode of Primeval Rune). In FGO, Primeval Rune raises one ally's Quick performance and buff success rate and charges their NP gauge.

scathach-ur.line: An aurochs rune that drenches and slows the target.
scathach-ur.icon: The Uruz rune shaped like horns, dripping water. A horned glyph. Sea blue on grey. Reads at 24px as: a horn glyph.
scathach-ur.lore: A rune of Scathach's Primordial Runes (mode of Primeval Rune). In FGO, Primeval Rune raises one ally's Quick performance and buff success rate and charges their NP gauge.

scathach-wisdom-clairvoyance.line: Foresees the fight: likely crits harder and more, and dodges.
scathach-wisdom-clairvoyance.icon: An eye inside a rune circle, stars in its iris. An eye in a ring. Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: an eye in a ring.
scathach-wisdom-clairvoyance.lore: Her Wisdom of Dun Scaith often shows as battlefield foresight, Clairvoyance, much as she foresaw Cu Chulainn's end in Ulster myth.

scathach-wisdom-of-dun-scaith.line: The great teacher copies skills from other heroes on the field.
scathach-wisdom-of-dun-scaith.icon: A fortress on a misty cliff with a scroll before it. A tower and a scroll. Grey and violet. Reads at 24px as: a tower and a scroll.
scathach-wisdom-of-dun-scaith.lore: The abyss-born intellect gained by surpassing humanity and killing gods, letting her display almost any skill at B to A rank and teach them to those she deems true heroes.

semiramis-arrogant-kings-poison.line: Spends three poisons to poison an area and weaken its armour.
semiramis-arrogant-kings-poison.icon: Three poison vials shattering into a violet cloud. Three shapes and a cloud. Violet. Reads at 24px as: a violet cloud.
semiramis-arrogant-kings-poison.lore: In FGO, Semiramis' Sikera Usum: Arrogant King's Alcohol (A / B+) poisons all enemies, lowers their Buster resistance and lets her inflict Poison when attacking.

semiramis-double-summon-caster.line: A chance to arrive as both Assassin and Caster, unlocking her gardens.
semiramis-double-summon-caster.icon: Two crowned silhouettes back to back, one with a dagger, one with a staff. Two figures. Gold and violet. Reads at 24px as: two back-to-back figures.
semiramis-double-summon-caster.lore: Double Summon grants her the class skills of both Assassin and Caster, an exceedingly rare trait.

semiramis-double-summon.line: Builds toward her floating palace and readies her ultimate.
semiramis-double-summon.icon: A scaffold of marble rising into the sky, plants spilling. A structure rising. Bone and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a rising structure.
semiramis-double-summon.lore: Double Summon grants her the class skills of both Assassin and Caster, an exceedingly rare trait.

semiramis-familiar-doves.line: Her doves spot everyone she has ever seen.
semiramis-familiar-doves.icon: A white dove with an eye on its wing. A bird shape. White and violet. Reads at 24px as: a white dove.
semiramis-familiar-doves.lore: She uses doves as familiars, directed by thought without a contract.

semiramis-hanging-gardens-of-babylon.line: Raises her flying palace above the battlefield.
semiramis-hanging-gardens-of-babylon.icon: An inverted palace floating in the sky, ringed by eleven black plates. An inverted wedge with dark orbs. Bone, verdant and black. Reads at 24px as: an inverted palace.
semiramis-hanging-gardens-of-babylon.lore: A flying fortress in which all her parameters rise a rank, her fame peaks and other Servants' fame drops to zero; eleven black plates orbit it as cannons.
semiramis-hanging-gardens-of-babylon.look: An enormous fortress hanging in the air, orbited by eleven pure black plates over 20 meters long.

semiramis-hgob-aerial-garden-of-vanity.line: The flying palace bombards a wide square of ground below it.
semiramis-hgob-aerial-garden-of-vanity.icon: The Hanging Gardens seen from below: an upside-down palace of marble, vines trailing, firing beams straight down. An inverted wedge with vertical lines under it. Bone white stone, verdant vines, Mana-blue beams. Reads at 24px as: an inverted triangle raining lines.
semiramis-hgob-aerial-garden-of-vanity.lore: The Hanging Gardens of Babylon (Aerial Garden of Vanity) is a giant floating fortress, Nebuchadnezzar II's Noble Phantasm, usable by Semiramis and her strongest, largest one.
semiramis-hgob-aerial-garden-of-vanity.look: Floating masses covered in marble floors, balconies, pillars and tangled plant life, like an upside-down palace.

semiramis-hgob-dragon-wing-warriors.line: Harpy-winged soldiers dive in waves, striking everything in an area again and again.
semiramis-hgob-dragon-wing-warriors.icon: Three harpy-winged soldiers diving in a staggered line, wings swept back like arrowheads. Three stacked chevrons. Bone ink bodies, ember-gold wingtips on night. Reads at 24px as: three falling chevrons.
semiramis-hgob-dragon-wing-warriors.lore: Semiramis' special modified flying soldiers, defending the Hanging Gardens of Babylon.
semiramis-hgob-dragon-wing-warriors.look: Upper halves of regular soldiers with the lower halves of Harpies.

semiramis-item-construction.line: Brews a few vials of her poison.
semiramis-item-construction.icon: A round alchemist's flask with a glowing liquid and a small gear stamped on the glass. A round-bottomed flask. Verdant liquid in smoked glass on violet night. Reads at 24px as: a round green flask.
semiramis-item-construction.lore: Lets her create items that carry magical energy, but she specializes in poisons and can make nothing else.

semiramis-poison.line: A vial of the queen's poison that she can hand to an ally to drink.
semiramis-poison.icon: A slim cut-glass vial with a dove-shaped stopper, filled with dark violet liquid. A narrow upright bottle. Violet glow inside smoked glass, gold stopper. Reads at 24px as: a small violet bottle.

semiramis-scales-of-the-sacred-fish.line: Raises a shield of fish scales over herself or an ally.
semiramis-scales-of-the-sacred-fish.icon: A shield of overlapping iridescent fish scales. A curved scaled plate. Pearl and guard blue. Reads at 24px as: a scaled shield.
semiramis-scales-of-the-sacred-fish.lore: She can form the scales of the Sacred Fish on her hand as a defence; in the anime she makes a scale shield to protect others.
semiramis-scales-of-the-sacred-fish.look: Scales formed on her hand, or a shield of scales.

semiramis-sikera-usum.line: Her poison spreads as chains, poisoning everything in an area.
semiramis-sikera-usum.icon: Chains of violet poison coiling out from a goblet. A cup with chains. Violet and gold. Reads at 24px as: a cup with chains.
semiramis-sikera-usum.lore: Invoked only at her fortress's throne, it grants her magecraft a poison attribute; poison-resistant legends resist it better and poison victims take double.
semiramis-sikera-usum.look: Poison appears in the form of chains.

semiramis-summoning-basmu.icon: A horned serpent rearing from a magic circle. A coiled shape in a ring. Violet and green. Reads at 24px as: a serpent in a ring.
semiramis-summoning-basmu.lore: Inside her Hanging Gardens she can summon Phantasmal creatures tied to poison anecdotes, such as the Basmu; the wiki describes this under Sikera Usum.
semiramis-summoning-basmu.look: A Phantasmal Species poison creature such as the Basmu.

semiramis-territory-creation.line: Strong at home: hits harder in her base, and allies there take less.
semiramis-territory-creation.icon: A magic circle glowing on a stone floor, with low walls of light rising at its rim. A flattened ellipse with a rising rim. Crimson-violet circle on deep violet night. Reads at 24px as: a glowing ring on the ground.
semiramis-territory-creation.lore: Creates ground advantageous to a magus; with enough materials she can build a Hanging Garden, which is superior to a temple.

serenity-danse-macabre.line: A death dance: her poisons and killing blows land far more often.
serenity-danse-macabre.icon: A dancer's veil swirling, violet mist trailing from it. A swirling ribbon. Violet. Reads at 24px as: a violet swirl.
serenity-danse-macabre.lore: Dance of Pale Death (A), the Grand Order upgrade of Dance of Silence: her dance scatters poison that weakens targets and raises her Noble Phantasm's success.
serenity-danse-macabre.look: Poison is scattered through her dance.

serenity-projectile.line: Poisoned daggers: every hit poisons, and some poison deeply.
serenity-projectile.icon: Three white kunai-shaped daggers in flight, violet drops on their tips. Three narrow shapes. White and violet. Reads at 24px as: three daggers.
serenity-projectile.lore: Poisoned Blade (C++) lets her fight with dirks at range and melee, adding a Poison status; her daggers are white and kunai-shaped.
serenity-projectile.look: Her personal dirks are white kunai-shaped daggers.

serenity-shapeshift.line: Infiltrates a foe: delays their ultimate and dulls their crits.
serenity-shapeshift.icon: A mask peeling to reveal another face. A face with a lifted edge. Bone and violet. Reads at 24px as: a peeling mask.
serenity-shapeshift.lore: Infiltration-specialised shapeshifting: she can change her appearance to a person of similar build, even the opposite sex, to approach her target.

serenity-silent-dance.line: Silent grace: her poisons and lethal effects land a bit more often.
serenity-silent-dance.icon: A bare foot on tiptoe, no sound rings. A foot shape. Bone and violet. Reads at 24px as: a tiptoe foot.
serenity-silent-dance.lore: Dance of Silence (B): a charm-type dance that scatters poison to weaken the target and improve her Noble Phantasm's application.

serenity-zabaniya.line: Her body is poison: anyone near her is poisoned every turn.
serenity-zabaniya.icon: A woman's outline exhaling a sweet violet haze, a blooming flower in it. A figure in a haze. Violet and rose. Reads at 24px as: a violet haze.
serenity-zabaniya.lore: Her whole body is poison: nails, skin, fluids and even her sweet scent are lethal, and any contact is fatal, typically by a poisonous kiss.

sieg-akafiloga-argrise.line: Breathes the dragon's fire over an area, melting its armour.
sieg-akafiloga-argrise.icon: A dragon's open jaw pouring incandescent fire onto liquefying ground. A jaw and a flood. Ember and black. Reads at 24px as: fire from a jaw.
sieg-akafiloga-argrise.lore: A Noble Phantasm that transforms him temporarily into the dragon Fafnir and unleashes a massive dragon's breath, drawn from his legend of turning into a dragon and flying.
sieg-akafiloga-argrise.look: Fafnir's dragon form; the transformation destroys his body, leaving only his soul.

sieg-akafiloga-fafnir.line: Transforms into the dragon Fafnir, vastly stronger and tougher.
sieg-akafiloga-fafnir.icon: The silhouette of the great dragon Fafnir, wings spread. A dragon shape. Black and ember. Reads at 24px as: a dragon silhouette.
sieg-akafiloga-fafnir.lore: The same Noble Phantasm's transformation: Sieg's dragon-blooded heart from Siegfried transfigures him into Fafnir.
sieg-akafiloga-fafnir.look: Forced transformation into the dragon Fafnir.

sieg-blasted-tree.line: A lightning strike on one foe that splashes on all around them.
sieg-blasted-tree.icon: A split tree struck by lightning, sparks flying. A cracked trunk and a bolt. Yellow shock and black. Reads at 24px as: a struck tree.
sieg-blasted-tree.lore: A suicidal Noble Phantasm of Frankenstein whose life and will passed to Sieg; he uses a much weaker version in the final battle as a trump card.

sieg-bridal-chest.line: A homunculus's weapon: close blows are physical, distant ones lightning.
sieg-bridal-chest.icon: A slender bladed halberd crackling with lightning. A pole weapon with sparks. Steel and yellow. Reads at 24px as: a sparking halberd.
sieg-bridal-chest.lore: Reborn inside him as a piece of Frankenstein, it grants a 'perpetual motion machine' ability to transform and fire Balmung repeatedly.

sieg-dead-count-shapeshifter.line: Spends a black seal to become Siegfried for a while.
sieg-dead-count-shapeshifter.icon: A black Command Seal on a left hand glowing, a dragon-slayer's greatsword forming. A dark mark and a blade. Black and ember. Reads at 24px as: a dark mark and a blade.
sieg-dead-count-shapeshifter.lore: By using his Command Spells he temporarily uses Siegfried's inserted heart and transforms into him, downloading the hero's body, experience, abilities and Noble Phantasms for about three minutes.
sieg-dead-count-shapeshifter.look: Special black Command Seals on the back of his left hand.

sieg-dragon-revelation.line: Black seals that ready his ultimate and fuel his dragon power.
sieg-dragon-revelation.icon: Three black Command Seal strokes on a left hand, one dimming. A three-part dark mark. Black and ember. Reads at 24px as: a dark three-part mark.
sieg-dragon-revelation.lore: The Dragon Revelation Command Spells, combined with Man-made Hero (False), let him act as a hero or Servant for a short time.
sieg-dragon-revelation.look: Black Command Seals on his left hand that darken as they are used.

sieg-galvanism.line: Magic hitting him charges his ultimate and spells.
sieg-galvanism.icon: A frog-leg twitch of current through a body, sparks at the joints. A body with sparks. Yellow shock. Reads at 24px as: sparks on a figure.
sieg-galvanism.lore: A mana-replenishing ability that lets him fire Balmung repeatedly, heal from heart shots and slow the toll of spent Command Spells.
