sieg-heilen.line: A healing spell on an ally nearby.
sieg-heilen.icon: A green rune glowing over an open hand. A glyph over a palm. Verdant. Reads at 24px as: a green glyph.

sieg-homunculus.line: An artificial being: magic blows hit harder, curses land less.
sieg-homunculus.icon: A glass flask holding a curled figure with ruby eyes. A flask with a figure. Glass and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a figure in a flask.
sieg-homunculus.lore: A C+ skill from his creation as a homunculus by the Musik family, who borrowed Einzbern techniques; he was born with a personality and strong magecraft talent.
sieg-homunculus.look: Slender, frail, with dark red ruby eyes and brown hair.

sieg-knacken.line: A breaking spell that cracks one foe's defences.
sieg-knacken.icon: A rune cracking a plate of armour. A glyph on a cracked plate. Mana blue and steel. Reads at 24px as: a cracked plate.

sieg-magecraft.line: Can cast spells, one per turn.
sieg-magecraft.icon: A magic circle forming in an open palm. A ring above a hand. Mana blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue ring.
sieg-magecraft.lore: Natural talent of homunculus magic circuits: he understands a target's structure and destroys solids with an opposing composition; Sieg can use nothing else.

sieg-man-made-hero.line: Borrows a hero's shape: tougher, and his ultimate charges faster.
sieg-man-made-hero.icon: A slender silhouette overlaid by a taller armoured one. Two overlapping figures. Bone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a figure with a taller shadow.
sieg-man-made-hero.lore: He is a man-made pseudo-hero thanks to Siegfried's heart and Frankenstein's current; combined with a Dragon Revelation Command Spell he can briefly act as a Servant.
sieg-man-made-hero.look: He grows taller and more slender, resembling Saber.

sieg-schwert.line: A sword spell that sharpens his strikes for a moment.
sieg-schwert.icon: A blade of blue light forming over a hand. A glowing blade. Mana blue. Reads at 24px as: a blue blade.

siegfried-armor-of-fafnir.line: Dragon-blood skin: weak attacks do nothing, except at one spot on his back.
siegfried-armor-of-fafnir.icon: Dragon-blood-dyed skin with a single leaf-shaped bare patch on the back. A back shape with a mark. Bronze-brown and silver. Reads at 24px as: a back with a leaf mark.
siegfried-armor-of-fafnir.lore: A constantly active armor from bathing in dragon blood that negates attacks of B rank and below, downgrades A-rank attacks, and rises to B+ against Noble Phantasms.
siegfried-armor-of-fafnir.look: Radiant silver woven plate armor over skin dyed brown by dragon blood, with a weak spot on his back.

siegfried-avaricious-gold.line: Hoarded gold: his crits ready the ultimate even faster.
siegfried-avaricious-gold.icon: A dragon's hoard of gold coins in a heap. A mound of discs. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold heap.
siegfried-avaricious-gold.lore: An A-rank upgrade of Golden Rule: he took the Nibelungs' treasure and a lifetime of wealth, but his Luck suffers for it.

siegfried-balmung.line: Releases a twilight wave from his greatsword across an area.
siegfried-balmung.icon: A greatsword with a blue hilt jewel, unleashing a fan of twilight light. A blade under a wide arc. Blue jewel, amber twilight. Reads at 24px as: a blade under an arc.
siegfried-balmung.lore: A cursed holy sword that slew the dragon, unleashing a wide-range attack with extra damage against dragon-attribute foes.
siegfried-balmung.look: Phantasmal greatsword with a blue hilt jewel that glows with a twilight aura when released.

siegfried-dragon-slayer.line: A dragon slayer: hurts dragons more and guards against them.
siegfried-dragon-slayer.icon: A sword through a dragon's skull. A blade through a horned shape. Steel and ember. Reads at 24px as: a blade in a skull.
siegfried-dragon-slayer.lore: A skill gained by those who killed a dragon-kind, greatly boosting offence and defence against dragons; the slaying anecdote itself turned into a skill.

sita-curse-of-separation.line: Survives a killing blow, heals, and draws strength from the curse.
sita-curse-of-separation.icon: Two hands reaching for each other, a crack between them. Two hands and a gap. Gold and crimson. Reads at 24px as: two hands apart.
sita-curse-of-separation.lore: Rama was cursed for killing the monkey Bali, so he and Sita can never meet; Sita is not cursed herself but is affected by it.

sita-goddesses-divine-core.line: A goddess's core: every hit is stronger, and curses miss more.
sita-goddesses-divine-core.icon: A glowing seed-like core inside a lotus petal. A bright dot in a petal. White-gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a dot in a petal.
sita-goddesses-divine-core.lore: Reflects Rama as an avatar of Vishnu and Sita as an avatar of Lakshmi, Vishnu's wife.

sita-haradhanu-janaka.line: Clears her curses, fires a long shot, then heals better.
sita-haradhanu-janaka.icon: A heavy bow drawn, a single arrow of gentle gold light. A bow arc. Gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a bow.
sita-haradhanu-janaka.lore: Shiva's bow, passed down through King Janaka's line, that only Sita could lift as a child and that Rama later snapped; she can string it using another Rama's power.

sita-jewel-of-the-earth.line: Allies near her take less damage and resist curses.
sita-jewel-of-the-earth.icon: A glowing gem rising out of a furrow in the earth. A gem over a line. Verdant and gold. Reads at 24px as: a gem on the ground.
sita-jewel-of-the-earth.lore: From the tale of her appearing at the tip of her father's spade; the earth loves and protects her.

sita-pilgrimage-in-agni-pariksha.line: Walks through fire unharmed: draws attacks and shrugs off burns.
sita-pilgrimage-in-agni-pariksha.icon: A woman walking through a wall of flame untouched. A figure in fire. Ember and white. Reads at 24px as: a figure in flame.
sita-pilgrimage-in-agni-pariksha.lore: From the story of Sita entering fire to prove her purity, and being burned by no flame.

summoning-elder-horror.line: Calls up one great sea horror next to him.
summoning-elder-horror.icon: Base: a large tentacled horror rising from a circle. Accent: the circle is drawn from his spellbook as Caster, and from his sword's tip as Saber. Reads at 24px as: one big mass in a ring.
summoning-elder-horror.lore: Summoning of deep-sea water demons and a massive evil god from another world through Prelati's Spellbook.

summoning-horrors.line: Calls up a handful of small horrors around him.
summoning-horrors.icon: Base: several small tentacled horrors crawling from circles. Accent: as for Elder Horror. Reads at 24px as: small masses in rings.
summoning-horrors.lore: Summoning of deep-sea water demons and familiar horrors from another world through Prelati's Spellbook.

tamamo-dainissho.line: Under the sacred mirror, a great sun blast over a wide area.
tamamo-dainissho.icon: Base: the Yata mirror. Accent: a blazing sun bursting from its face. Reads at 24px as: a mirror with a sun.
tamamo-dainissho.lore: Yata no Kagami (mode of Eightfold Blessing of Amaterasu): the mirror-shaped Noble Phantasm, the temporarily released form of the sacred treasure Tamamo Shizuishi. In FGO the NP reduces party cooldowns and recovers HP.
tamamo-dainissho.look: A Noble Phantasm in the shape of a mirror.

tamamo-enten.line: A fire mantra that may set the target burning.
tamamo-enten.icon: A paper talisman bursting into fox-fire. A slip with a flame. Ember. Reads at 24px as: a burning slip.
tamamo-enten.lore: Jusō Enten (Curse: Fiery Heaven) is a fire spell; in Extra it deals magic damage and Stun against Break.
tamamo-enten.look: A controllable spurt of flames in Extella Link.

tamamo-foxs-wedding.line: A sun shower blessing that heals an ally and restores luck.
tamamo-foxs-wedding.icon: Rain falling through sunlight with a fox's shadow. Drops and rays. Gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: sunlit rain.
tamamo-foxs-wedding.lore: An Item Construction skill reworked by Tamamo after seeing Suzuka Gozen's Noble Phantasm: she declares a wedding one-sidedly, showering allies with blessings and souvenirs.

tamamo-higanbana-sesshoseki.line: The killing stone curses its target, worse for the frail.
tamamo-higanbana-sesshoseki.icon: A red spider lily blooming from a cracked stone. A spiky flower on a rock. Crimson and grey. Reads at 24px as: a red spiky flower.
tamamo-higanbana-sesshoseki.lore: The Red Spider Lily Killing Stone skill, dealing magic damage and Poison, usable only when her HP is below 30% in game.

tamamo-hyoten.line: An ice mantra that may disable the target.
tamamo-hyoten.icon: Five balls of ice shooting from a talisman. A slip with dots. Ice white. Reads at 24px as: a slip with white dots.
tamamo-hyoten.lore: Jusō Hyōten (Curse: Frigid Heaven) is an ice spell; in Extra it deals magic damage and Stun against Attack.
tamamo-hyoten.look: Five balls of ice shoot forward in Extella Link.

tamamo-kokutendo.line: Slips into a lightless state to avoid harm.
tamamo-kokutendo.icon: A dark cave mouth swallowing a fox's tail. A black arch. Black and violet. Reads at 24px as: a dark arch.
tamamo-kokutendo.lore: Jusō Kokutendō (Mantra: Aphotic Cave) is a self-applied skill that lowers damage and absorbs MP; in Extella Link it is a counter guard state.

tamamo-konissho.line: A sunlight mantra that badly delays a foe's ultimate.
tamamo-konissho.icon: A sun disc stamped on a talisman, its light pinning a shadow. A slip with a sun. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a slip with a sun.
tamamo-konissho.lore: Mantra: Boundless Sunlight. In FGO, it may reduce an enemy's NP gauge by 1 and raises party NP damage except Tamamo's own.

tamamo-kuretsu-daimitten.line: A chaotic mantra that hits hard and likely stuns.
tamamo-kuretsu-daimitten.icon: A void crack splitting the air, wind howling out. A jagged split. Violet and teal. Reads at 24px as: a jagged crack.
tamamo-kuretsu-daimitten.lore: Her 'final secret technique', a void-magic curse she used to lock Suzuka Gozen in place.

tamamo-mitten.line: A wind mantra that pierces and breaks defences.
tamamo-mitten.icon: A tornado spiralling from a talisman. A funnel. Teal. Reads at 24px as: a funnel.
tamamo-mitten.lore: Jusō Mitten (Curse: Chaos Heaven) is an air spell; in Extra it deals magic damage and Stun against Guard.
tamamo-mitten.look: A tornado surrounding her in Extella Link.

tamamo-polygamist-castration-fist.line: A brutal kick combo, devastating against men.
tamamo-polygamist-castration-fist.icon: A fox-eared figure mid jump kick, motion lines behind. A leaping kick shape. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a flying kick.
tamamo-polygamist-castration-fist.lore: Her kick technique that critically strikes male enemies.
tamamo-polygamist-castration-fist.look: Repeated front kicks, a somersault kick and a finishing jump kick.

tamamo-raitei.line: A thunder mantra that may shock everyone in an area.
tamamo-raitei.icon: A cursed ball of lightning bursting. A crackling sphere. Yellow shock. Reads at 24px as: a lightning ball.
tamamo-raitei.lore: Jusō Raitei (Curse: Thunderclap) is a restriction spell that fires a cursed exploding ball, stunning enemies in the blast.

tamamo-shapeshift.line: A shapeshifter's body: takes less damage.
tamamo-shapeshift.icon: A figure dissolving into pages and reforming. A silhouette of flying sheets. Bone and blue. Reads at 24px as: a figure of pages.
tamamo-shapeshift.lore: As a kitsune she can change appearance or species at will, though a traumatic past incarnation makes her seldom use it.

tamamo-witchcraft.icon: A fox mask with nine tails fanning behind it. A mask and tails. Gold and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a fan of tails.
tamamo-witchcraft.lore: Her Curse Arts recompose the raw materials of her own body rather than her surroundings, tied to Dakiniten methods, and she rarely uses these formidable skills.

tamamo-yata-no-kagami.line: Raises a sacred mirror's field that powers her spells within it.
tamamo-yata-no-kagami.icon: A round bronze mirror with a sun rising behind it. A disc with rays. Bronze and gold. Reads at 24px as: a bronze disc.
tamamo-yata-no-kagami.lore: Her mirror, one of the Japanese sacred treasures tied to Amaterasu, that raises a barrier cutting off Tokoyo's logic and making magic cost nothing inside.
tamamo-yata-no-kagami.look: A mirror; the in-game version is a barrier.

tamamo-yata-strike.line: A swing of the mirror for a random burst of damage.
tamamo-yata-strike.icon: Base: the Yata mirror. Accent: swung in an arc, a die tumbling. Reads at 24px as: a mirror in an arc.
tamamo-yata-strike.lore: Yata no Kagami (mode of Eightfold Blessing of Amaterasu): the mirror-shaped Noble Phantasm, the temporarily released form of the sacred treasure Tamamo Shizuishi. In FGO the NP reduces party cooldowns and recovers HP.
tamamo-yata-strike.look: A Noble Phantasm in the shape of a mirror.

vlad-berserker-bloodsucking.line: Drinks a foe's blood, delaying their ultimate and readying his.
vlad-berserker-bloodsucking.icon: Two fangs with a drop of blood between them. Two points and a drop. Bone and crimson. Reads at 24px as: fangs and a drop.
vlad-berserker-bloodsucking.lore: Vampiric ability to enslave others, even Servants, by drinking their blood; it counts as affection, not an attack, so it cannot be defended against.

vlad-berserker-fearsome-immortal.line: Refuses to stay dead: survives a killing blow.
vlad-berserker-fearsome-immortal.icon: A shadowy figure rising from a coffin. A figure over a box. Black and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a figure rising.
vlad-berserker-fearsome-immortal.lore: A Grand Order upgrade of Battle Continuation, giving great resilience and survivability.

vlad-berserker-kazikli-bey.line: Stakes burst from his body, cursing and breaking the target.
vlad-berserker-kazikli-bey.icon: Stakes of bone and shadow bursting outward from a body. Spikes radiating. Black and crimson. Reads at 24px as: radiating spikes.
vlad-berserker-kazikli-bey.lore: Berserker's version of the impaling Noble Phantasm: it can destroy one Servant by shooting stakes from inside his own body, also usable under Legend of Dracula.
vlad-berserker-kazikli-bey.look: Stakes shot from his body made of wood, bone, flesh, shadow and hair.

vlad-berserker-legend-of-dracula.line: Becomes the vampire: heals by night and grows monstrous.
vlad-berserker-legend-of-dracula.icon: Base: a bat-winged silhouette with blood-red eyes. Accent: as Berserker, claws bared and clothes torn. Reads at 24px as: a winged figure with red eyes.
vlad-berserker-legend-of-dracula.lore: By becoming Dracula he loses other skills and Noble Phantasms but gains huge physical power, mist and animal forms, healing and charming eyes, plus sunlight and holy weaknesses.
vlad-berserker-legend-of-dracula.look: Blood-red eyes, fangs, claws, torn aristocratic clothes, flesh like shadow.

vlad-berserker-shapeshift.line: A shapeshifter's body: takes less damage, more on demand.
vlad-berserker-shapeshift.icon: A figure dissolving into pages and reforming. A silhouette of flying sheets. Bone and blue. Reads at 24px as: a figure of pages.
vlad-berserker-shapeshift.lore: A vampiric ability to turn into mist or countless bats, useful in melee but weak against wide-area attacks.

vlad-demonic-defender-of-the-state.line: Marks his homeland on the field; inside it he is far stronger.
vlad-demonic-defender-of-the-state.icon: A crowned shield over a marked square of land. A shield over a square. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a shield on a square.
vlad-demonic-defender-of-the-state.lore: The ability to mark a region as his dominion by securing its leylines; within it he fights with a Mad Enhancement A-like bonus and Kazikli Bey becomes usable.

vlad-kazikli-bey-execution.line: Raises stakes under everyone he has marked, damaging them all.
vlad-kazikli-bey-execution.icon: Base: rows of stakes. Accent: they burst up together under several marked figures. Reads at 24px as: many spikes rising.
vlad-kazikli-bey-execution.lore: The Lord of Execution form: up to 20,000 stakes in his domain, with stakes bursting from within an enemy his spear strikes.
vlad-kazikli-bey-execution.look: Long stakes several meters tall rising from the ground and hoisting victims.

vlad-kazikli-bey.line: Each of his blows plants a mark that a later execution will use.
vlad-kazikli-bey.icon: A single tall stake rising from the ground. A tall spike. Dark wood and crimson. Reads at 24px as: one tall spike.
vlad-kazikli-bey.lore: A Noble Phantasm sublimating the legend of the impaled soldiers shown to Mehmed II, filling his domain with attacking and blocking stakes.
vlad-kazikli-bey.look: Long stakes several meters tall sprouting from the earth.

vlad-legend-of-dracula.line: With a Command Seal, he becomes the vampire Dracula.
vlad-legend-of-dracula.icon: Base: a bat-winged silhouette with blood-red eyes. Accent: as Lancer, a royal cloak still on the shoulders. Reads at 24px as: a winged figure with red eyes.
vlad-legend-of-dracula.lore: The Dracula legend ability that turns him into a monster-vampire, sealing his normal skills and Noble Phantasms and granting vampire powers.
vlad-legend-of-dracula.look: Blood-red eyes, fangs, claws, torn clothes, shadow-like flesh.

vlad-shapeshift.line: A shapeshifter's body: takes less damage, more on demand.
vlad-shapeshift.icon: A figure dissolving into pages and reforming. A silhouette of flying sheets. Bone and blue. Reads at 24px as: a figure of pages.
vlad-shapeshift.lore: A vampiric ability to turn into mist or countless bats, useful in melee but weak against wide-area attacks.

vorpal-blade.line: A short beheading blade: much stronger hits at close range, deadly to demons.
vorpal-blade.icon: A crescent-curved short blade with a checkerboard grip, its edge catching a thin white line of light. A crescent hook. Steel and bone ink, a white edge glint. Reads at 24px as: a white crescent.
vorpal-blade.lore: A Conceptual Weapon from Fate/EXTRA, made by the alchemist Rani VIII; it inhibits (weakens) the enemy's strength, and was transmuted from a malachite.

yan-qing-doppelganger.line: Disguises himself as any other figure on the field.
yan-qing-doppelganger.icon: A mask held up to a face, a second face showing behind. A face and a mask. Bone and teal. Reads at 24px as: a mask and a face.
yan-qing-doppelganger.lore: An EX transformation skill that dilutes his self so he can copy others' looks and some Skills, but not Noble Phantasms.

yan-qing-espionage.line: A spy's craft: crits more and stays hidden while acting.
yan-qing-espionage.icon: An eye peering through a gap in a curtain. An eye in a slit. Teal. Reads at 24px as: an eye in a gap.
yan-qing-espionage.lore: An A-rank skill for infiltrating enemy organisations and gaining powerful trust, passing information through illegal channels.

yan-qing-fist.line: His fighting style: huge crit chance and more against the lawful.
yan-qing-fist.icon: A fist with a tiger tattoo striking. A fist with stripes. Ink and gold. Reads at 24px as: a striped fist.
yan-qing-fist.lore: The Grand Order upgrade of Chinese Boxing, an EX-rank martial art he is believed to have originated.

yan-qing-np.line: Ambush from ten sides: a savage strike plus random extra effects.
yan-qing-np.icon: Ten shadow fists surrounding one point. A ring of fists. Black and teal. Reads at 24px as: a ring of fists.
yan-qing-np.lore: Clone strikes through the footwork of Yan Qing Quan: not sorcery, but to observers an imperceptible stepping followed by multiple blows.

yan-qing-ruffian.line: A brawler's grit: harder crits, and can burn footing for more damage.
yan-qing-ruffian.icon: A bandaged fist with a scrape. A wrapped fist. Bone and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a wrapped fist.
yan-qing-ruffian.lore: A composite of Riding and Independent Action that grows stronger at banquets and similar occasions.

yan-qing-skillful-star.line: Gives up his own crits so nearby allies crit more.
yan-qing-skillful-star.icon: A star passed from one open hand to another. Two hands and a star. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a star between hands.
yan-qing-skillful-star.lore: Marks him as one of the 108 Stars of Destiny, reborn as heroes; he was the Skillful Star, skilled at the exquisite, and bears a calamitous karmic burden.

yan-qing-zhong-guo-quan-fa.line: Chinese boxing: crits more, and each hit readies his ultimate.
yan-qing-zhong-guo-quan-fa.icon: A boxer's open palm strike with a swirl of qi. A palm and a swirl. Teal and gold. Reads at 24px as: a palm with a swirl.
yan-qing-zhong-guo-quan-fa.lore: Chinese Boxing (EX): a martial art whose mastery aims at becoming one with the universe; he is believed to be the originator of many quan fa styles.

class-alter-ego.line: An alter ego: deals more and takes more against outsider beings.
class-alter-ego.icon: A face split down the middle into two different masks. A divided oval. Violet and gold. Reads at 24px as: a split mask.
class-alter-ego.lore: Alter Ego is a non-standard Extra Servant class made of beings split off from another, such as the Sakura Five and the Tamamo Nine.

class-avenger.line: Takes more damage, but strikes back harder by the same amount.
class-avenger.icon: A black flame rising from a broken chain. A flame over a gap. Black fire with a crimson edge. Reads at 24px as: a dark flame.
class-avenger.lore: Castor's skill symbolizing his vengeful desires against humans, held naturally as an Avenger.

class-battle-continuation.line: Takes less damage, and once per stretch stands back up after being killed.
class-battle-continuation.icon: A warrior on one knee, leaning on a planted sword, still rising, with an ember glow at the wound. The kneeling-swordsman silhouette, backlit. Gold backlight on night. Reads at 24px as: a kneeling figure and a vertical blade.
class-battle-continuation.lore: A Skill that lets a Servant keep fighting after mortal wounds and lowers the mortality of injuries; it reflects a vitality and refusal to give up.
class-battle-continuation.look: The wiki illustrates it with a user fighting on despite a fatal wound, with no fixed visual effect.

class-bravery.line: Fearless: resists mind tricks and can boost physical damage.
class-bravery.icon: A lion's face roaring in gold. A rounded mane shape. Ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold mane.
class-bravery.lore: Nullifies mental interference such as coercion, confusion and glamour, and raises melee damage.

divinity.line: Divine blood: every hit this unit lands is a little stronger.
divinity.icon: A radiant sun disc with long, fine rays, a faint eye-shaped hollow at its core. A circle with rays. Pure white-gold on night, the brightest icon in the set. Reads at 24px as: a gold sun.
divinity.lore: A Skill measuring a Servant's aptitude as a Divine Spirit; high ranks make a demigod, and it falls as the Spirit's Monster or Demonic Beast nature rises.

class-existence-outside-the-domain.line: From outside the world: resists curses and death, and takes less.
class-existence-outside-the-domain.icon: An eye-shaped rift in space with tentacled stars behind it. An almond rift. Violet and black. Reads at 24px as: a violet rift.
class-existence-outside-the-domain.lore: A class skill marking one descended from the outer realms of the Imaginary Void, possessed by an evil god and wielding a portent of its Authority.

class-gods-resolution.line: A divine judgement that stuns one foe, no matter their resistance.
class-gods-resolution.icon: A crown-topped gavel striking a beam of light. A hammer and a burst. Gold and yellow shock. Reads at 24px as: a gavel strike.
class-gods-resolution.lore: Ruler class skill: a Ruler receives two Command Spells for every Servant in a Holy Grail War, but cannot repurpose Command Spells already used.

class-independent-action-viy.line: Viy acts for her: hard to steal, and her crits are keener.
class-independent-action-viy.icon: Base: the cloaked figure walking out of frame with a broken chain. Accent: a huge eye watches from the cloak. Reads at 24px as: a walking figure with an eye.
class-independent-action-viy.lore: A variation of Independent Action letting her act without a Master's mana supply, so long as Viy is near. She prefers to stay by her Master.

class-independent-action.line: Can act far from its Master and is hard for enemies to steal.
class-independent-action.icon: A cloaked figure walking away out of frame, a broken chain trailing from one wrist. A striding silhouette with a loose line behind. Agility teal ground, bone ink figure. Reads at 24px as: a walking figure with a trailing line.
class-independent-action.lore: The ability to stay independent while rejecting the Master's mana supply, acting even without the Master; at higher ranks a Servant can linger without a contract.

class-item-construction-gogh.line: Allies nearby land curses more easily and shrug them off better.
class-item-construction-gogh.icon: A round alchemist's flask with a glowing liquid and a small gear stamped on the glass. A round-bottomed flask. Verdant liquid in smoked glass on violet night. Reads at 24px as: a round green flask.
class-item-construction-gogh.lore: A Caster-class Skill for manufacturing magical items, from implements of war to daily goods; it takes time to gather components and craft them.

class-mad-enhancement.line: Goes berserk: tougher and fiercer, but it drains the Master each turn.
class-mad-enhancement.icon: A ring of fangs seen from inside a roaring maw, a single red eye glinting above. A ring of teeth. Bone white teeth, blood-brown ground, one crimson glint. Reads at 24px as: a ring of white teeth.
class-mad-enhancement.lore: Berserker's Class Skill: it raises basic parameters and physical power in exchange for dulled reason, and may seal some Skills or Noble Phantasms.
class-mad-enhancement.look: Users lose composed speech and thought, becoming aggressive or talking mostly to themselves.

class-magic-resistance-weakness.line: Her magic resistance falters against attacks made to hunt her kind.
class-magic-resistance-weakness.icon: Base: the four-diamond ward rune. Accent: a crack running through one diamond. Reads at 24px as: a white cross with a crack.
class-magic-resistance-weakness.lore: Magic Resistance is a skill that cancels spells and neutralizes grand sorceries below its rank, though divine mysteries and dragon-slaying sorcery can overwhelm it. The weakness variant is not on the page.

class-magic-resistance.line: Shrugs off magic: weak spells fail outright, strong ones hurt less, curses miss.
class-magic-resistance.icon: A ward rune of four interlocked diamonds deflecting a scatter of spell sparks. A cross of diamonds. White lattice on a guard-blue vortex. Reads at 24px as: a white diamond cross.
class-magic-resistance.lore: A Skill that protects against magical effects by cancelling spells outright, rather than merely rejecting mana; it is the Class Skill of Saber, Lancer, Archer, Rider and other classes.

class-oblivion-correction.line: Forgotten, he strikes where no one expects: more critical hits.
class-oblivion-correction.icon: A blurred figure whose face is erased, a sharp star where the eyes should be. A faceless head with a spark. Grey and gold. Reads at 24px as: a blank head with a star.
class-oblivion-correction.lore: Zeus's divine blood was forgotten in later legends but kept in Castor's Saint Graph, so Castor never forgets he is a fallen god.

class-presence-concealment.line: Vanishes from sight for two turns: enemies cannot target it.
class-presence-concealment.icon: A blank white mask dissolving into smoke, no features but two hollow eyes. An oval mask fading at its edges. Bone white in grey smoke on night. Reads at 24px as: a pale oval in dark smoke.
class-presence-concealment.lore: The capacity to hide one's presence as a Servant, and the Assassin class's Class Skill.

class-pretender.line: A role-wearer: strong against alter egos and certain others.
class-pretender.icon: A theatre mask held on a stick in front of a face. A mask on a stick. Gold and violet. Reads at 24px as: a mask on a stick.
class-pretender.lore: The Pretender class is made of those who became heroes while feigning another identity; the wiki page gives no skill text beyond the class concept.

class-riding-achilles.line: A born rider: moves twice, and charges through lines while mounted.
class-riding-achilles.icon: A rider's spur and a looping rein, the spur's rowel spinning like a star. A star on a curved line. Gold metal on agility-teal dusk. Reads at 24px as: a gold star on a curve.
class-riding-achilles.lore: Skill at riding; phantasmal beasts and divine beasts can serve as mounts, though dragon kind cannot.

class-riding-drake.line: Rides for a turn: moves far, moves twice, and can charge through a line.
class-riding-drake.icon: A rider's spur and a looping rein, the spur's rowel spinning like a star. A star on a curved line. Gold metal on agility-teal dusk. Reads at 24px as: a gold star on a curve.
class-riding-drake.lore: Skill at operating most mounts, but not monstrous or divine beasts. Her rank rises only when riding ships.

class-riding-medusa.line: A born rider: always moves twice, more when riding.
class-riding-medusa.icon: A rider's spur and a looping rein, the spur's rowel spinning like a star. A star on a curved line. Gold metal on agility-teal dusk. Reads at 24px as: a gold star on a curve.
class-riding-medusa.lore: A high Riding rank covering nearly all beasts including Phantasmal and Divine Beasts but not dragons; her best steed is the winged horse Pegasus.
class-riding-medusa.look: Rider and Pegasus move as one when she rides the steed born of her own blood.

class-riding-ozymandias.line: Rides his sun-boat: moves twice and charges through lines.
class-riding-ozymandias.icon: A rider's spur and a looping rein, the spur's rowel spinning like a star. A star on a curved line. Gold metal on agility-teal dusk. Reads at 24px as: a gold star on a curve.
class-riding-ozymandias.lore: A Riding A+ that lets him manage beasts up to Phantasmal and Divine Beasts, though not dragons.

pale-rider-riding.line: Death's mount: can't be harmed, but never attacks directly.
pale-rider-riding.icon: A rider's spur and a looping rein, the spur's rowel spinning like a star. A star on a curved line. Gold metal on agility-teal dusk. Reads at 24px as: a gold star on a curve.
pale-rider-riding.lore: A unique Riding EX in which it 'rides' the wind, humanity and the world itself.

class-riding-pollux.line: Rides for a turn: moves far, moves twice, and can charge through a line.
class-riding-pollux.icon: A rider's spur and a looping rein, the spur's rowel spinning like a star. A star on a curved line. Gold metal on agility-teal dusk. Reads at 24px as: a gold star on a curve.
class-riding-pollux.lore: Pollux has a B rank Riding aptitude, a talent that comes with being a Saber.

class-riding-unlocks.line: Rides for a turn: moves farther, moves twice, and can charge through a line.
class-riding-unlocks.icon: A rider's spur and a looping rein, the spur's rowel spinning like a star. A star on a curved line. Gold metal on agility-teal dusk. Reads at 24px as: a gold star on a curve.
class-riding-unlocks.lore: A Skill denoting a Servant's ability to ride mounts and vehicles; high ranks are typical for Riders, and dragon-type mounts need a different ability.

class-riding.line: A born rider: always moves twice and can charge through a line of foes.
class-riding.icon: A rider's spur and a looping rein, the spur's rowel spinning like a star. A star on a curved line. Gold metal on agility-teal dusk. Reads at 24px as: a gold star on a curve.
class-riding.lore: A Skill denoting a Servant's ability to ride mounts and vehicles; high ranks are typical for Riders, and dragon-type mounts need a different ability.

class-self-replenishment-mana.line: Recovers health and readies the ultimate a little every turn.
class-self-replenishment-mana.icon: A small fountain of light refilling a cup. A rising jet over a bowl. Mana blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue jet over a cup.
class-self-replenishment-mana.lore: As an Avenger, Castor naturally holds Self-Replenishment of mana.

class-territory-creation.line: Strong at home: hits harder in its own base, and allies there take less damage.
class-territory-creation.icon: A magic circle glowing on a stone floor, with low walls of light rising at its rim. A flattened ellipse with a rising rim. Crimson-violet circle on deep violet night. Reads at 24px as: a glowing ring on the ground.
class-territory-creation.lore: The Skill to build a terrain advantageous to a magus, for gathering mana or making magical objects; Rank B allows a Workshop and Rank A a Temple.
class-territory-creation.look: Territories vary by Servant, such as a study or a performance venue.

class-true-name-discernment.line: Learns everything about an enemy Servant the moment they meet.
class-true-name-discernment.icon: An open book with a name glowing on its page, an eye above. A book under an eye. Gold and violet. Reads at 24px as: an eye over a book.
class-true-name-discernment.lore: Ruler class skill: on directly meeting a Servant, the Ruler automatically learns its true identity, skills and parameters; Servants with concealment depend on her luck to evade it.

cs-all-cooldown.line: The Master spends a Command Seal: every skill recharges one step.
cs-all-cooldown.icon: The three-stroke Command Seal on the back of a hand, one stroke flaring, a ring of small hourglasses around it all turning at once. Crimson seal on bone skin, gold hourglasses. Reads at 24px as: a red three-part mark in a gold ring.
cs-all-cooldown.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-all-cooldown.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-cure-servant.line: The Master spends a Command Seal to wash every curse off their Servant.
cs-cure-servant.icon: The flaring Command Seal, with a ring of dark motes bursting outward and dissolving into white. Crimson seal, motes turning from violet to white. Reads at 24px as: a red mark scattering dots.
cs-cure-servant.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-cure-servant.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-damage-block.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-damage-block.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-damage-up.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-damage-up.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-escape.line: The Master spends a Command Seal to whisk both of them home.
cs-escape.icon: The flaring Command Seal, with two silhouettes dissolving into crimson light that streams toward a small gate. Reads at 24px as: a red mark trailing toward a gate.
cs-escape.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning. The wiki mentions escape among its uses.
cs-escape.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-force-noble-phantasm.line: Spends a Command Seal to unleash the ultimate even when it is spent.
cs-force-noble-phantasm.icon: The flaring Command Seal, with a sword point-down above it, chains around it snapping. Crimson seal, white-gold sword. Reads at 24px as: a red mark under a downward blade.
cs-force-noble-phantasm.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-force-noble-phantasm.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-full-cooldown.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-full-cooldown.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-full-heal.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning. The wiki mentions healing among its uses.

cs-half-heal.icon: Base: the Full Heal chalice. Accent: the cup is half full. Reads at 24px as: a red mark under a half-lit cup.

cs-halve-noble-phantasm.icon: The flaring Command Seal, with a downward enemy sword struck by a crimson diagonal that splits it in two. Reads at 24px as: a red mark under a split blade.
cs-halve-noble-phantasm.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-halve-noble-phantasm.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-kill-humans.line: The Master forces a good Servant to kill bystanders, and it never forgives them.
cs-kill-humans.icon: The flaring Command Seal, with a crimson tear running down from it. Dark and unlit: the one Command Seal icon with no gold. Reads at 24px as: a red mark with a falling drop.
cs-kill-humans.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-kill-humans.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-kill-yourself.line: The Master orders their Servant to destroy itself.
cs-kill-yourself.icon: The Command Seal burning out, all three strokes guttering, with a blade turned inward. Crimson fading to ash. Reads at 24px as: a dim red mark and a turned blade.
cs-kill-yourself.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning. The wiki mentions forcing a Servant to kill itself.
cs-kill-yourself.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-noble-phantasm-max.line: The Master spends a Command Seal to double the Servant's ultimate attack.
cs-noble-phantasm-max.icon: The flaring Command Seal under a white-gold star of a Noble Phantasm, doubled in crimson outline. Reads at 24px as: a red mark under a doubled star.
cs-noble-phantasm-max.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning. The wiki mentions boosting Noble Phantasm output among its uses.
cs-noble-phantasm-max.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-reduce-cooldown.icon: The flaring Command Seal under an hourglass, a single grain falling. Reads at 24px as: a red mark under a small hourglass.

cs-shisarot-form.line: The Master spends a Command Seal to transform Habetrot into her beast form.
cs-shisarot-form.icon: The flaring Command Seal, with a lion-dog shisa head rising out of it. Crimson seal, sun-gold shisa. Reads at 24px as: a red mark under a beast head.
cs-shisarot-form.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-shisarot-form.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-survive-kill.line: The Master spends a Command Seal so their Servant survives a killing blow.
cs-survive-kill.icon: The flaring Command Seal under the kneeling-swordsman silhouette, a crimson thread holding it up. Reads at 24px as: a red mark under a kneeling figure.
cs-survive-kill.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning. The wiki mentions reviving a Servant among its uses.
cs-survive-kill.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-suspend-skill.line: Spends a Command Seal to switch one Servant skill off for a while.
cs-suspend-skill.icon: The flaring Command Seal under a gem crossed by a crimson X. Reads at 24px as: a red mark under an X.
cs-suspend-skill.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning.
cs-suspend-skill.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

cs-teleport-servant.line: The Master spends a Command Seal to pull their Servant to their side instantly.
cs-teleport-servant.icon: The flaring Command Seal, with a figure appearing from crimson light right beside the hand. Reads at 24px as: a red mark beside a figure.
cs-teleport-servant.lore: A Command Spell is one of three claims of absolute obedience a Master holds over a Servant, a crystallization of great magic carved in at summoning. The wiki mentions teleportation among its uses.
cs-teleport-servant.look: A holy mark on the arm, most commonly the back of the right hand, in three parts that fade with use.

me-angels-song.line: Once per battle, the Servant's ultimate attack hits two and a half times as hard.
me-angels-song.icon: A single feather with a musical staff curling around it. A tall curved quill. Bone white feather, gold staff lines on night. Reads at 24px as: a white feather.
me-angels-song.lore: A Craft Essence featuring Irisviel von Einzbern that boosts NP damage. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-antumbra.line: The Servant's ordinary attacks hit a fifth harder.
me-antumbra.icon: A gem eclipsing a light behind it, a dark disc with a burning gold corona. A ring of light around a dark circle. Gold corona on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold ring.
me-antumbra.lore: Gem Magecraft: Antumbra, a Craft Essence featuring Luviagelita Edelfelt. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-azoth-blade.line: The Servant takes noticeably less damage.
me-azoth-blade.icon: A ritual dagger with a hollow pommel holding a drop of quicksilver, laid across a small shield. A short blade over a shape. Silver and guard blue. Reads at 24px as: a short blade over blue.

me-black-keys-b.icon: Three thin cross-hilted throwing blades fanned like keys, their blades tinted Luck violet. A fan of three narrow crosses. Reads at 24px as: three violet lines.
me-black-keys-b.lore: The Blue Black Keys, a Friend Point Craft Essence of exorcist implements. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-black-keys-g.icon: Base: the Black Keys fan. Accent: the blades are tinted Agility teal. Reads at 24px as: three teal lines.
me-black-keys-g.lore: The Green Black Keys: a cross-modeled exorcist's tool used to contact the spirit world, in a Friend Point Craft Essence. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-black-keys-r.icon: Base: the Black Keys fan. Accent: the blades are tinted Health red. Reads at 24px as: three red lines.
me-black-keys-r.lore: The Red Black Keys, a Friend Point Craft Essence about the Black Keys, flung bladed exorcist implements; it raises Buster performance. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-chance.line: The Servant lands critical hits more often.
me-chance.icon: A coin spinning on its edge, one face catching a four-point star of light. A thin upright ellipse with a spark. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold sliver with a spark.

me-concentration.line: Once per battle, the Servant's ultimate attack comes back a turn sooner.
me-concentration.icon: A closed eye with a single line of light running down from it into a point. Bone ink on night, a gold line. Reads at 24px as: a closed eye over a line.
me-concentration.lore: Concentration, a basic Friend Point Craft Essence. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-crystal.line: Once per battle, the Servant's ultimate attack comes back two turns sooner.
me-crystal.icon: A clear faceted crystal with light refracting through it into two beams. A tall hexagonal prism. Ice-white with gold refractions. Reads at 24px as: a white prism.

me-destruction.line: Raises the Servant's maximum Health a little.
me-destruction.icon: A clenched gauntlet shattering a stone block. A fist over fragments. Health red glow in the cracks, steel gauntlet. Reads at 24px as: a fist in a burst.
me-destruction.lore: Destruction, a basic Craft Essence that raises Buster performance; removed after Lostbelt 1. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-divine-banquet.line: Once per battle, the Servant's ultimate attack comes back three turns sooner.
me-divine-banquet.icon: A laden banquet goblet overflowing with golden light. A wide cup with a rising glow. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold cup.
me-divine-banquet.lore: Divine Banquet, a Craft Essence featuring Sella and Leysritt. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-dragonkind.line: Once per battle, the Servant's ultimate attack hits twice as hard.
me-dragonkind.icon: A dragon's slit eye opening behind a sword. A vertical slit in an almond. Ember gold iris on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold slit eye.
me-dragonkind.lore: Dragonkind, a Friend Point Craft Essence that raises NP damage. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-elegance.line: The Servant lands critical hits far more often.
me-elegance.icon: A rose stem crossed with a rapier, a four-point star at the blade's tip. Crossed lines. Rose and steel on night. Reads at 24px as: a crossed X with a star.

me-false-attendant.line: The Servant shrugs off curses a little more often.
me-false-attendant.icon: A closed book with a small seal of a hooded figure on its cover. A rectangle with an emblem. Bone ink and guard blue. Reads at 24px as: a book shape.
me-false-attendant.lore: False Attendant's Writings, a Friend Point Craft Essence featuring Matō Shinji. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-flash.line: The Servant's ordinary attacks hit a little harder.
me-flash.icon: A single blade-flash: a thin diagonal streak of white light. A sharp diagonal line. White on night with gold fringe. Reads at 24px as: a white slash.
me-flash.lore: Flash, a basic Craft Essence that raises critical damage. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-formalcraft.line: Raises the Servant's maximum Luck a good deal.
me-formalcraft.icon: A ritual circle drawn in chalk, its lines geometric and precise, a small star at its heart. A circle in a square. Luck violet on night. Reads at 24px as: a violet circle-in-square.
me-formalcraft.lore: Formal Craft, a Craft Essence featuring Tōsaka Rin and the five elements (Earth, Water, Fire, Wind, Ether), described as 'a beautiful, elegant Average'. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-gandr.icon: A pointing index finger firing a hazy black orb. A hand and a dark ball. Agility teal rim light on the orb. Reads at 24px as: a dark dot with a teal ring.
me-gandr.lore: A simple Scandinavian curse that concentrates magical energy into the forefinger to fire a shot that decreases the target's physical health.
me-gandr.look: A hazy black orb fired like a bullet from the index finger.

me-grimoire.line: The Servant lands critical hits more often.
me-grimoire.icon: An open spellbook with a four-point star rising from its pages. A V-shaped book with a spark. Gold star, bone pages. Reads at 24px as: an open book with a star.
me-grimoire.lore: Spell Tome (also known as Grimoire), a Friend Point Craft Essence that raises critical star generation. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-harvest.line: The Servant's ultimate attack is ready one round earlier.
me-harvest.icon: A single ripe ear of grain bending under its weight. A curved stalk. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold curved stalk.
me-harvest.lore: Plentiful Harvest, a basic Craft Essence that starts battle with some NP gauge charged. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-heavens-feel.line: Once per battle, the Servant's ultimate attack hits three times as hard.
me-heavens-feel.icon: A grail chalice radiating a cross of white light. A cup under a starburst. White-gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a cup under a bright cross.
me-heavens-feel.lore: The Third Magic, Heaven's Feel, materializes the soul so it escapes dispersion and gains true immortality as a higher-dimensional being.

me-imaginary-around.line: Raises the Servant's maximum Agility a good deal.
me-imaginary-around.icon: A spiral of overlapping translucent rings, like reality folding. Concentric offset circles. Agility teal on night. Reads at 24px as: a teal spiral.
me-imaginary-around.lore: Imaginary Around, a Craft Essence featuring Matō Sakura that raises Quick performance. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-imaginary-number.line: The Servant's ultimate attack is ready three rounds earlier.
me-imaginary-number.icon: A shadow-black sphere with a sharp i-glyph cut out of it in light. A dark ball with a white mark. Reads at 24px as: a black ball with a white tick.

me-kaleidoscope.line: The Servant's ultimate attack is ready four rounds earlier.
me-kaleidoscope.icon: A jewelled sword whose blade splits into mirrored facets showing parallel stars. A blade shattering into shards. Prismatic white on starry night. Reads at 24px as: a prism-split blade.
me-kaleidoscope.lore: The Second Magic, Kaleidoscope (Zelretch), whose domain is the operation of parallel worlds: observing them, time travel and limited resurrection.
me-kaleidoscope.look: Seen in a jet-black, star-dotted Observation Room, with openings into parallel worlds.

me-leyline.line: The Servant's ultimate attack is ready two rounds earlier.
me-leyline.icon: Glowing veins of light running through dark earth and meeting in a node. Branching lines to a point. Mana blue on night. Reads at 24px as: blue branches meeting.
me-leyline.lore: Ley Line, a Friend Point Craft Essence; 'a leyline is the heartbeat of a single, gigantic lifeform'. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-limited-zero-over.line: Raises the Servant's maximum Health a great deal.
me-limited-zero-over.icon: A sword with its edge glowing past its own outline, light overflowing it. A blade with a large aura. Health red aura on night. Reads at 24px as: a blade in a red glow.
me-limited-zero-over.lore: Limited/Zero Over, a Craft Essence featuring Emiya Shirō, themed on the complete form of Shirō as a magus. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-meditation.line: The Servant shrugs off curses a little more often.
me-meditation.icon: A seated figure in meditation, a soft ring of light around its head. A triangular seated silhouette. Bone ink with a gold halo. Reads at 24px as: a seated triangle with a ring.
me-meditation.lore: Meditation, a basic Craft Essence removed after Lostbelt 1. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-oracle.line: Once per battle, the Servant's ultimate attack hits half again as hard.
me-oracle.icon: A veiled eye with a single gold tear of light. An almond shape. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: an eye with a falling dot.
me-oracle.lore: Divine Oracle, a Friend Point Craft Essence that raises NP damage. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-pendant.line: The Servant's ordinary attacks hit noticeably harder.
me-pendant.icon: A jewel pendant on a fine chain, the red gem catching a star. A teardrop on a line. Crimson gem, gold chain. Reads at 24px as: a red drop on a chain.
me-pendant.lore: Rin's Pendant, a Craft Essence: the jewel pendant used as the catalyst that summoned the Heroic Spirit EMIYA in Fate/stay night. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-preemption.line: Raises the Servant's maximum Agility a little.
me-preemption.icon: An arrow already loosed, only its fletching still in frame. A short feathered stub. Agility teal on night. Reads at 24px as: a teal fletching.
me-preemption.lore: Preemption, a basic Craft Essence that raises Quick performance. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-primeval-magic.line: The Servant shrugs off curses more often.
me-primeval-magic.icon: A primitive rune carved in stone, glowing faintly. An angular glyph on a slab. Guard blue light on grey stone. Reads at 24px as: a blue rune.
me-primeval-magic.lore: Primeval Curse, a Craft Essence featuring Atrum Galliasta that raises debuff resistance. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-projection.icon: A sword drawn in wireframe light, half solid. A blade in outline. Luck violet lines on night. Reads at 24px as: a violet wire blade.
me-projection.lore: Projection (Gradation Air) materializes an object from magical energy according to the caster's imagination; the replica slowly fades as the World recognizes the inconsistency.

me-steel-training.line: The Servant takes much less damage.
me-steel-training.icon: A wooden practice sword wrapped in steel bands. A blade with crossbands. Steel and guard blue. Reads at 24px as: a banded blade.

me-technique.line: Raises the Servant's maximum Luck a little.
me-technique.icon: A single fencing parry: two blades crossing at the tip. A narrow X. Luck violet glint. Reads at 24px as: a thin X.
me-technique.lore: Technique, a basic Craft Essence removed after Lostbelt 1. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)

me-tenacity.line: The Servant takes a little less damage.
me-tenacity.icon: A clenched fist wrapped in cloth tape. A fist shape. Guard blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue fist.
me-tenacity.lore: Tenacity, a basic Craft Essence ('training turns the body to rock') that raises defense. (Source describes the Craft Essence this essence is named for.)
